muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ومن يعص الله ورسوله ويتعد حدوده يدخله نارا خالدا فيها وله عذاب مهين﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; مَن is a jussive-governing conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); يعص is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa" (he); the Name of Majesty (الله) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); رسوله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ويتعد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿يتعد﴾ is an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿يعص﴾, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the yāʾ, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "huwa"; وحدوده: the wāw is a conjunction [Translator's note: so in the source; the wāw in this word is not separate in the Quranic text, which reads ﴿حدوده﴾ without a wāw], and حدود is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; يدخله is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; نارا is the second mafʿūl bihi; خالدا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدا﴾; وله: the wāw is a conjunction, and له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and مهين is a naʿt (adjective), nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿واللاتي يأتين الفاحشة من نسائكم﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; اللاتي is a relative noun; the clause ﴿يأتين الفاحشة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من نسائكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فاستشهدوا عليهن أربعة منكم﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), because of the flavour of a condition contained in the relative noun, or [else] the khabar (predicate) is omitted; ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استشهدوا; أربعة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective).
﴿فإن شهدوا فأمسكوهن في البيوت﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; شهدوا is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the fāʾ is connective; أمسكوهن is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; في البيوت is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أمسكوهن; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). The clause ﴿فإن شهدوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى يتوفاهن الموت أو يجعل الله لهن سبيلا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; يتوفاهن is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أمسكوهن; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; الموت is the fāʿil; أو is a conjunction; يجعل is an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿يتوفاهن﴾; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and سبيلًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿واللذان يأتيانها منكم فآذوهما﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; اللذان is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يأتيانها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللذان﴾, with no grammatical position. The pronoun refers back to الفاحشة (the indecency). منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); آذوهما is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the khabar (predicate).
﴿فإن تابا وأصلحا فأعرضوا عنهما﴾: فإن: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إن is conditional; تابا is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); أصلحا is conjoined to ﴿تابا﴾; the fāʾ is connective; and the clause ﴿أعرضوا عنهما﴾ is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). The clause ﴿فإن تابا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله كان توابا رحيما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and توابا رحيما are its two predicates; and the clause of ﴿كان﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إنما التوبة على الله للذين يعملون السوء بجهالة﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] and its restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); التوبة is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; السوء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بجهالة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ثم يتوبون من قريب﴾: ثم is a conjunction; يتوبون is conjoined to ﴿يعملون﴾; and ﴿من قريب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوبون﴾.
﴿فأولئك يتوب الله عليهم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; أولئك is a demonstrative and the mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿يتوب الله عليهم﴾ is the khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان الله عليمًا حكيمًا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; عليما is its khabar; حكيمًا is a second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وليست التوبة للذين يعملون السيئات﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ليس is an abrogating past verb; التوبة is its noun; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿يعملون السيئات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى إذا حضر أحدهم الموت﴾: ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and a preposition; إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause ﴿حضر أحدهم الموت﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); أحدهم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الموت is a postponed fāʿil (agent); the whole conditional clause is in the position of genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يعملون﴾.
﴿قال إني تبت الآن﴾: The clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the yāʾ is its noun; the clause تبت is its khabar; الآن is an adverb attached to تبت; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿ولا الذين يموتون وهم كفار﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; الذين is conjoined to ﴿الذين يعملون﴾; the clause ﴿يموتون﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and كفار the khabar; and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أولئك أعتدنا لهم عذابًا أليمًا﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿أعتدنا﴾ is the khabar; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعتدنا﴾; عذابًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and أليمًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; and هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh). الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾. ﴿آمنوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا يحل لكم أن ترثوا النساء كرها﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. لا is negating; يحل is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحل﴾; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from ﴿أن ترثوا النساء﴾ is the fāʿil of يحل; النساء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and كرهًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا تعضلوهن لتذهبوا ببعض ما آتيتموهن﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; ﴿تعضلوهن﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ترثوا﴾, i.e., "nor that you prevent them"; لتذهبوا: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl), and تذهبوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تعضلوهن﴾; ببعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تذهبوا﴾; ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿آتيتموهن﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلا أن يأتين بفاحشة مبينة﴾: A disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يأتين﴾ is accusative as the excepted; or it is an exception connected to what precedes it, being an exception from the most general of circumstances, [so it is] a ḥāl. It has also been said: it is excepted from the most general of times or of reasons, accusative as an adverb of time; and it has been said: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). يأتين is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of accusative by ﴿أن﴾; بفاحشة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; and مبينة is a ṣifa.
﴿وعاشروهن بالمعروف﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; عاشروهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فإن كرهتموهن فعسى أن تكرهوا شيئا ويجعل الله فيه خيرا كثيرا﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; كرهتموهن is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); فعسى: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and عسى here is complete (tāmma), and it is an inflexible (jāmid) verb, and أن with what follows it is its fāʿil; يجعل is an imperfect verb conjoined by the wāw to تكرهوا, accusative like it, and the wāw is its fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil of يجعل is actually the Name of Majesty (الله), and يجعل has no wāw of the plural]; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجعل, and so it stands in place of the second object of يجعل; خيرًا is its first object; كثيرًا is a ṣifa; and the clause ﴿فإن كرهتموهن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وإن أردتم استبدال زوج مكان زوج﴾: The wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional; أردتم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); استبدال زوج is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and مكان زوج is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) استبدال.
﴿وآتيتم إحداهن قنطارا فلا تأخذوا منه شيئا﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); آتيتم is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); إحداهن is the first mafʿūl bihi, and قنطارًا the second mafʿūl bihi; فلا: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and لا is prohibitive; تأخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأخذوا﴾; شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis). The clause ﴿وإن أردتم استبدال...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أتأخذونه بهتانا وإثما مبينا﴾: The hamza is for interrogation, rebuke and disapproval, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; تأخذونه is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; بهتانًا is a ḥāl, or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); إثمًا is conjoined to ﴿بهتانًا﴾; and مبينًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وكيف تأخذونه وقد أفضى بعضكم إلى بعض وأخذن منكم ميثاقا غليظا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); تأخذونه is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); أفضى بعضكم is a verb and its fāʿil; إلى بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفضى; أخذن is conjoined to أفضى, and the nūn is the fāʿil; ميثاقًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and غليظًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ولا تنكحوا ما نكح آباؤكم من النساء﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تنكحوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or it is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e., "do not marry like the corrupt marrying of your fathers", and it, together with what it governs, is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); نكح آباؤكم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and من النساء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إلا ما قد سلف إنه كان فاحشة ومقتا وساء سبيلا﴾: إلا is a particle of exception, and ما is the excepted, accusative. The clause ﴿قد سلف﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿كان فاحشة﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause ﴿إنه﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; مقتًا is conjoined to فاحشة; ساء is a past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil is a vague (mubham) latent pronoun. سبيلًا: a tamyīz (specification), accusative, and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿سبيل ذلك النجاح﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, "the way of that النجاح (success)"; most likely a misprint for النكاح (marriage), i.e., "the way of that marriage"]. The clause ﴿ساء سبيلا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿حرمت عليكم أمهاتكم﴾: حرم is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) حرمت; and أمهاتكم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وبناتكم وأخواتكم وعماتكم وخالاتكم وبنات الأخ وبنات الأخت﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أمهاتكم.
﴿وأمهاتكم اللاتي أرضعنكم﴾: Also conjoined.
﴿وأخواتكم من الرضاعة﴾: Also conjoined, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أخواتكم.
﴿وأمهات نسائكم وربائبكم اللاتي في حجوركم من نسائكم﴾: Also conjoined; في حجوركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and من نسائكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from ربائبكم.
﴿اللاتي دخلتم بهن﴾: The relative noun is a ṣifa (adjective) of نسائكم, and the clause ﴿دخلتم بهن﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿اللاتي﴾, with no grammatical position. The bāʾ is for transitivity (taʿdiya), i.e., "you entered into privacy with them".
﴿فإن لم تكونوا دخلتم بهن فلا جناح عليكم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; لم تكونوا is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the clause ﴿دخلتم بهن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun; and عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar. The clause ﴿فإن لم تكونوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وحلائل أبنائكم الذين من أصلابكم﴾: Conjoined to what preceded; الذين is a ṣifa of أبنائكم; and من أصلابكم, the preposition and its genitive noun, is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن تجمعوا بين الأختين إلا ما قد سلف﴾: The first maṣdar (verbal noun) [Translator's note: so in the source, «المصدر الأول»; probably a misprint for «المصدر المؤول», "the interpreted maṣdar"] is also conjoined; بين is an adverb attached to ﴿تجمعوا﴾, and الأختين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا is a particle of exception, and ما is the excepted, accusative. The clause ﴿قد سلف﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله كان غفورا رحيما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and غفورا رحيما are its two predicates; the clause is the khabar of إن; and the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿والمحصنات من النساء إلا ما ملكت أيمانكم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the forbidden women mentioned before; من النساء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا: a particle of exception; ما is a connected excepted, and it has been said: disconnected; and the clause ملكت أيمانكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿كتاب الله عليكم﴾: كتاب is an emphasizing maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e., "Allah has prescribed that for you as a prescription"; and عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar.
﴿وأحل لكم ما وراء ذلكم﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; أحلَّ is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and it is conjoined to the verb that put the maṣdar in the accusative; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحل; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿وراء﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أن تبتغوا بأموالكم محصنين غير مسافحين﴾: The interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and what is in its domain is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative, and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted because it is known; محصنين is a first ḥāl, and غير مسافحين a second ḥāl.
﴿فما استمتعتم به منهن فآتوهن أجورهن فريضة﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, or a jussive-governing conditional noun, and it is the mubtadaʾ (subject) in either case; استمتعتم is the ṣila if ﴿ما﴾ is relative, and the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis) if it is conditional; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استمتعتم﴾; منهن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; فآتوهن: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and آتوهن: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of relative ﴿ما﴾, or in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of conditional ﴿ما﴾; أجورهن is the second mafʿūl bihi, the first object being the hāʾ in ﴿آتوهن﴾; and فريضة is a ḥāl from أجورهن, or an emphasizing noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar). The clause ﴿فما استمتعتم به...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا جناح عليكم فيما تراضيتم به من بعد الفريضة﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿لا﴾; ﴿فيما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿تراضيتم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تراضيتم﴾; and ﴿من بعد﴾ الفريضة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿إن الله كان عليما حكيما﴾: إن is a particle of emphasis; the Name of Majesty is its noun, accusative; كان is an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa" (He); عليما is the khabar of كان, accusative; حكيما is a second khabar; and the clause gives the reason for the rulings that have been stated.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ومن لم يستطع منكم طولا أن ينكح المحصنات المؤمنات﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لم يستطع﴾ is in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); طولًا is the object of ﴿يستطع﴾; and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن﴾ and ﴿ينكح﴾ is the object of ﴿طولًا﴾, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), or: it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e., "means [leading] to marrying the chaste women".
﴿فمن ما ملكت أيمانكم من فتياتكم المؤمنات﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e., "then let him marry a slave woman from among those whom your right hands possess"; the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانكم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; ﴿من فتياتكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the implied pronoun in ﴿ما ملكت﴾ that refers back to ﴿ما﴾; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of relative ﴿مَن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, «الموصولة» (relative); above, the source parsed ﴿مَن﴾ as a conditional noun]; and المؤمنات is a ṣifa of فتيات.
﴿والله أعلم بإيمانكم﴾: The wāw is parenthetical; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; أعلم is the khabar; بإيمانكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم; and the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿بعضكم من بعض﴾: بعضكم is the mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فانكحوهن بإذن أهلهن﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ), because it discloses an implied condition, i.e., "if you know the straight course that deserves to be followed, then marry them"; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and بإذن أهلهن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وآتوهن أجورهن بالمعروف﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿فانكحوهن﴾; بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتوهن أجورهن﴾; and آتى puts two objects in the accusative, namely the hāʾ and أجورهن.
﴿محصنات غير مسافحات ولا متخذات أخدان﴾: محصنات is a ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi in His words ﴿فانكحوهن﴾; ﴿غير مسافحات﴾ is a second ḥāl; and ﴿ولا متخذات أخدان﴾ is conjoined to ﴿مسافحات﴾.
﴿فإذا﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition.
﴿أحصن﴾: A past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive); the nūn is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فإن﴾: The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis of إذا, and إن is conditional.
﴿أتين﴾: A past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ; and the nūn is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿بفاحشة﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أتين.
﴿فعليهن﴾: The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿نصف﴾: A postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ما﴾: A relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation.
﴿على المحصنات﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿من العذاب﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿فإن أتين﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the clause ﴿فعليهن نصف﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition. The clause ﴿فإذا أحصن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك لمن خشي العنت منكم﴾: ذلك is a demonstrative and the mubtadaʾ; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause ﴿خشي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; العنت is the mafʿūl bihi; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن تصبروا خير لكم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what is in its domain is the mubtadaʾ; خير is the khabar of the interpreted maṣdar; and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خير﴾. The clause ﴿وأن تصبروا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله غفور رحيم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; غفور is a first khabar and رحيم a second khabar; and the clause ﴿والله غفور رحيم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿يريد الله ليبين لكم ويهديكم سنن الذين من قبلكم﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿يريد الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ليبين﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl) or for consequence (ʿāqiba), and يبين is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريد﴾, and the object of يريد is omitted. Or the lām in ﴿ليبين﴾ is a connective [particle] (ṣila) for emphasizing the sense of futurity that is inherent in willing, and يبين is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied maṣdariyya أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يبين﴾ is the object of يريد, the implied meaning being: "Allah wills to make clear". ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿يهديكم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يبين﴾; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and سنن the second mafʿūl bihi, or it is accusative by removal of the preposition; الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and من قبلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ويتوب عليكم﴾: Conjoined to ﴿يبين﴾, and عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوب﴾.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عليم is a first khabar (predicate) and حكيم a second khabar; and the clause ﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿والله يريد أن يتوب عليكم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يريد is the khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن يتوب﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتوب﴾. The clause ﴿والله يريد...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويريد الذين يتبعون الشهوات﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding يريد; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause يتبعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and الشهوات is the mafʿūl bihi, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿أن تميلوا ميلا عظيما﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; تميلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what follows it is the object of يريد; ميلًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and عظيمًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿يريد الله أن يخفف عنكم﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يريد الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن يخفف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عنكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخفف.
﴿وخلق الإنسان ضعيفا﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, serving as the reason for the lightening; خلق is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive); الإنسان is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ضعيفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الإنسان.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تأكلوا أموالكم بينكم بالباطل﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أموالكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بينكم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) تأكلوا; and بالباطل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إلا أن تكون تجارة عن تراض منكم﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن تكون﴾ is accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); تجارة is the khabar (predicate) of تكون, and its noun is latent (mustatir), the implied meaning being: "unless the trade is a trade"; ﴿عن تراض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa, i.e., "a trade proceeding from mutual consent"; and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of تجارة.
﴿ولا تقتلوا أنفسكم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; لا is prohibitive; تقتلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by it; and أنفسكم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الله كان بكم رحيما﴾: The clause gives the reason for the prohibition, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb; its noun is latent; ﴿رحيما﴾ is its khabar; the clause of كان with its noun and khabar is in the position of the khabar of إن; and بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رحيما﴾.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وإذا حييتم بتحية فحيوا بأحسن منها أو ردوها﴾: resumptive (mustaʾnaf) speech, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), which is ﴿حيّوا﴾; the clause ﴿حييتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); «بتحية» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حييتم»; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the clause ﴿حيوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; «بأحسن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حيوا»; «منها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أحسن»; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and «ردوها» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿حيُّوا﴾.
﴿إن الله كان على كل شيء حسيبا﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh, of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; ﴿على كل شيء حسيبا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause of kāna with its noun and khabar is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.
[Translator's note: as written, the source makes «على كل شيء» attached to an omitted khabar and does not separately parse «حسيبا», which is itself the accusative khabar of «كان»; «على كل شيء» would normally be attached to «حسيبا».]

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of «لا» and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is the khabar of the Name of Majesty.
﴿ليجمعنكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «يجمعنكم» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; «إلى يوم القيامة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يجمعنكم»; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the omitted oath; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation, and «ريب» is the noun of ﴿لا﴾, indeclinable on the fatḥa; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومن أصدق من الله حديثا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; «أصدق» is the khabar; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أصدق»; «حديثًا» is a tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿ومن أصدق...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿فما لكم في المنافقين فئتين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; «في المنافقين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فئتين», or attached to an omitted [word] as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "two groups divided over the hypocrites"; «فئتين» is a ḥāl from the kāf and mīm in ﴿لكم﴾; and the clause ﴿فما لكم في المنافقين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله أركسهم بما كسبوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿أركسهم﴾ is the khabar. ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أركسهم﴾; the clause ﴿كسبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the bāʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أركسهم﴾. The clause ﴿والله أركسهم بما كسبوا﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أتريدون أن تهدوا من أضل الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī); the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and what falls within its scope is the object of ﴿تريدون﴾; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿أضل الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative.
﴿ومن يضلل الله فلن تجد له سبيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; «يضلل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and given a kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future; «تجد» is an imperfect verb, accusative/subjunctive (manṣūb) by «لن»; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سبيلًا﴾; «سبيلًا» is mafʿūl bihi; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «مَن»; and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿ودوا لو تكفرون كما كفروا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿ودوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لو﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the accusative as the object of «ودوا», i.e. "they wished your disbelief"; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "that you would disbelieve with a disbelief like their disbelief"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿كفروا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿كفروا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فتكونون سواء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «تكونون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «تكفرون»; the wāw is its noun, and «سواء» is its khabar (predicate).
﴿فلا تتخذوا منهم أولياء حتى يهاجروا في سبيل الله﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if this is their state — namely wishing for your disbelief — then do not take them as allies"; «لا» is prohibitive; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتخذوا» as its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أولياء» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition; «يهاجروا» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after «حتى»; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar made genitive by «حتى», the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «تتخذوا»; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تتخذوا»; and «في سبيل الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يهاجروا».
[Translator's note: the source parses «منهم» twice in this line, as written.]
﴿فإن تولوا فخذوهم واقتلوهم حيث وجدتموهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «تولوا» is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «خذوهم» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; «اقتلوهم» is conjoined to «خذوهم»; «حيث» is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to «اقتلوهم»; and the clause «وجدتموهم» is in the position of a genitive by annexation.
﴿ولا تتخذوا منهم وليا ولا نصيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تتخذوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil; «منهم» is the first object of «تتخذوا»; «وليًّا» is the second object of «تتخذوا»; and «ولا نصيرًا» is conjoined to ﴿وليًّا﴾.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿إلا الذين يصلون إلى قوم بينكم وبينهم ميثاق﴾: ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; «الذين» is excepted (mustathnā) from the pronoun in ﴿خذوهم واقتلوهم﴾; the clause ﴿يصلون إلى قوم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿إلى قوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصلون»; ﴿بينكم﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «بينهم» is an adverb conjoined to the adverb before it; «ميثاق» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم»; and the exception clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿أو جاءوكم حصرت صدورهم أن يقاتلوكم أو يقاتلوا قومهم﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, [conjoining] to ﴿يصلون﴾ and falling within the scope of the ṣila, or conjoining to the naʿt of «قوم»; the clause ﴿حصرت صدورهم﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), with «قد» implied, or without implying it; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يقاتلوكم﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from fighting you", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «حصرت»; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿أو يقاتلوا قومهم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يقاتلوكم﴾, and «قومهم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولو شاء الله لسلطهم عليكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿شاء الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the lām is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause ﴿لسلطهم عليكم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فلقاتلوكم فإن اعتزلوكم فلم يقاتلوكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿لقاتلوكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿سلطهم﴾, so it is an emphasis of the apodosis, or a badal (substitute) from the first; «فإن»: the fāʾ is resumptive and «إن» is conditional; ﴿اعتزلوكم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ولم يقاتلوكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اعتزلوكم﴾.
﴿وألقوا إليكم السلم﴾: also conjoined.
﴿فما جعل الله لكم عليهم سبيلا﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; «جعل» is a past verb that makes two objects accusative; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; «سبيلًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿فإن اعتزلوكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿ستجدون آخرين يريدون أن يأمنوكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the sīn is for continuous future; «تجدون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); «آخرين» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يريدون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of «آخرين»; and the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and what falls within its scope is the object of «يريدون».
﴿ويأمنوا قومهم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿كل ما ردوا إلى الفتنة أركسوا فيها﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ is a substitute for an adverb of time (nāʾib ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أركسوا﴾, containing the meaning of a condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿ردوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by annexation, the implied form being "every returning", with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "every time of being returned to the fitna". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the returning pronoun being omitted, the implied form being "every time they were returned in it to the fitna"; the clause ﴿ردوا﴾ is then in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿رُدوا﴾ is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أركسوا فيها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أركسوا﴾.
﴿فإن لم يعتزلوكم ويلقوا إليكم السلم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, inversion [to past meaning] and jussive; «يعتزلوكم» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿ويكفوا أيديهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ويلقوا إليكم السلم﴾.
﴿فخذوهم واقتلوهم حيث ثقفتموهم﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; the clause ﴿خذوهم﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; «اقتلوهم» is conjoined to ﴿خذوهم﴾; ﴿حيث﴾ is an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, attached to ﴿اقتلوهم﴾; and the clause ﴿ثقفتموهم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation. The clause ﴿فإن لم يعتزلوكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأولئكم جعلنا لكم عليهم سلطانا مبينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أولئكم﴾ is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of an accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «سلطانًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and «مبينًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ومن يفعل ذلك عدوانا وظلما﴾: The wāw is resumptive; مَن is conditional and the mubtadaʾ (subject); يفعل is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); ذلك is a demonstrative, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عدوانًا وظلمًا are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the place of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فسوف نصليه نارا﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); سوف is a particle of futurity; نصليه is an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and نارًا the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of conditional مَن. The clause ﴿ومن يفعل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); ﴿ذلك﴾ is its noun and يسيرًا its khabar; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسيرًا﴾, or to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of it; and the clause ﴿وكان ذلك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿إن تجتنبوا كبائر ما تنهون عنه﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; تجتنبوا is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); كبائر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿تنهون عنه﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; تنهون is an imperfect verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and عنه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنهون.
﴿نكفر عنكم سيئاتكم﴾: نكفر is the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); عنكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نكفر; and سيئاتكم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وندخلكم مدخلا كريما﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ندخلكم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نكفر﴾; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; مدخلًا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī), or an adverb of place; and كريمًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ولا تتمنوا ما فضل الله به بعضكم على بعض﴾: The wāw is resumptive and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تتمنوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿فضل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضل; بعضكم is a mafʿūl bihi; and على بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to فضل.
﴿للرجال نصيب مما اكتسبوا﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. للرجال: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); نصيب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of نصيب; and the clause اكتسبوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وللنساء نصيب مما اكتسبن﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the previous clause; للنساء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; نصيب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of نصيب; and the clause اكتسبن is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿واسألوا الله من فضله﴾: Conjoined to the prohibition. اسألوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the Name of Majesty is the first object, and the second is omitted; and من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of the omitted second object, i.e., "something of His bounty".
﴿إن الله كان بكل شيء عليما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and ﴿عليما﴾ is its khabar; the clause of ﴿كان﴾ with its noun and khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; and ﴿بكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليمًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿ولكل جعلنا موالي مما ترك الوالدان والأقربون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the tanwīn in كل is a substitute for a word, i.e., "for every people"; the clause جعلنا is a ṣifa (adjective) of قوم (people); the first object of جعلنا is omitted, i.e., "We made them"; موالي is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of the omitted postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e., نصيب (a share); the clause ترك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; الوالدان is the fāʿil (agent), and الأقربون is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it. The meaning is: "and for each of these whom We have made heirs there is a share of the inheritance left behind". Or: لكل is a fronted object of جعلنا, موالي is the second mafʿūl bihi, and the [omitted] muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) is "wealth", i.e., "for every [piece of] wealth We have made heirs", and مما ترك is a ṣifa.
﴿والذين عقدت أيمانكم فآتوهم نصيبهم﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; الذين is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ; the clause عقدت أيمانكم is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) because of the flavour of a condition contained in the relative noun; the clause آتوهم is the khabar of الذين; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and نصيبهم the second mafʿūl bihi. Or the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is nominative, conjoined to ﴿الوالدان والأقربون﴾; or it is accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), i.e., the object of an omitted verb; or it is conjoined to ﴿موالي﴾; and the object of عقدت is omitted, i.e., "[your right hands] contracted them".
﴿إن الله كان على كل شيء شهيدا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the khabar of إن; ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾; and شهيدًا is the khabar of the incomplete كان.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿الرجال قوامون على النساء بما فضل الله بعضهم على بعض﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. الرجال is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and قوامون its khabar (predicate); على النساء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قوامون﴾; بما فضل is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿قوامون﴾; the bāʾ is a causal preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), or relative, and the clause after it has no grammatical position on either interpretation; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); بعضهم is the object; and على بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل.
﴿وبما أنفقوا من أموالهم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; بما أنفقوا is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿قوامون﴾; the bāʾ is a causal preposition; ما is maṣdariyya, or relative, and the clause after it has no grammatical position on either interpretation; and من أموالهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنفقوا.
﴿فالصالحات قانتات حافظات للغيب﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, serving as a derivation (tafrīʿ) from what preceded; الصالحات is the mubtadaʾ; قانتات is a first khabar and حافظات a second khabar; and للغيب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حافظات. The clause ﴿فالصالحات قانتات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بما حفظ الله﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حافظات; ما is maṣdariyya, i.e., "because of Allah's guarding of them, since He protected them and enabled them to guard [things] in their husbands' absence"; or ما is relative, meaning "that which", and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e., "by that which Allah has secured for them of their husbands' dowries and maintenance for them"; and the clause after ﴿ما﴾ has no grammatical position.
﴿واللاتي تخافون نشوزهن﴾: The wāw is resumptive; اللاتي is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ; تخافون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; نشوزهن is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿تخافون نشوزهن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فعظوهن واهجروهن في المضاجع واضربوهن﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) because of the flavour of a condition contained in the relative noun; عظوهن is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of the relative noun; اهجروهن is likewise conjoined; and في المضاجع is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اهجروهن﴾. The clause ﴿واللاتي تخافون نشوزهن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن أطعنكم فلا تبغوا عليهن سبيلا﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; أطعنكم is a past verb, the nūn is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi, and it is in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the fāʾ is connective for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); لا is prohibitive; تبغوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿سبيلًا﴾ and was placed before it; and سبيلًا is the mafʿūl bihi; or ﴿تبغوا﴾, the meaning being: "then do not transgress against them", so ﴿عليهن﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the accusative of ﴿سبيلًا﴾ on this [reading] is by dropping of the preposition [Translator's note: the sentence beginning "or ﴿تبغوا﴾" is elliptical in the source; it apparently means that تبغوا may be taken in the sense of "transgress (against)"]. The clause ﴿فإن أطعنكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله كان عليا كبيرا﴾: إن is a particle of emphasis; the Name of Majesty is its noun, accusative; كان is an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa" (He); عليا is the khabar of كان, accusative, and كبيرا a second khabar; and the clause ﴿كان عليًّا كبيرًا﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وإن خفتم شقاق بينهما﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); شقاق is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بينهما is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct): شقاق has been annexed to the adverb by way of extension (ittisāʿ), its original form being "a discord between them".
﴿فابعثوا حكما من أهله﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); ابعثوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; حكمًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and من أهله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective).
﴿وحكما من أهلها﴾: ﴿حكما﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿حكما﴾, and من أهلها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa.
﴿إن يريدا إصلاحا يوفق الله بينهما﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; يريدا is the protasis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; إصلاحًا is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يوفق الله﴾ is the apodosis, and the clause has no grammatical position; and بينهما is an adverb attached to ﴿يوفق﴾.
﴿إن الله كان عليما خبيرا﴾: إن is a particle of emphasis; the Name of Majesty is its noun, accusative; كان is an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa" (He); عليما is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative, and خبيرا a second khabar; the clause ﴿كان عليما خبيرا﴾ is the khabar of إن; and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿واعبدوا الله ولا تشركوا به شيئا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; اعبدوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty its object; لا تشركوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; لا is prohibitive; تشركوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تشركوا﴾. ﴿شيئًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e., "anything of all things", or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e., "any [degree] of association". The clause ﴿واعبدوا الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وبالوالدين إحسانا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; بالوالدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted verb of the maṣdar (verbal noun); and إحسانًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb.
﴿وبذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين والجار ذي القربى والجار الجنب والصاحب بالجنب﴾: All of them are conjoined, and بالجنب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وابن السبيل﴾: Also conjoined.
﴿وما ملكت أيمانكم﴾: ما is a relative noun conjoined to what preceded, and the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله لا يحب من كان مختالا فخورا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يحبّ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); مَن is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; the noun of كان is latent (mustatir); مختالًا is the first khabar of كان, and فخورًا its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿الذين يبخلون ويأمرون الناس بالبخل﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of every blame and reproach"; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e., "they are those who"; or it is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مَن كان﴾, and so enters into the scope of what precedes it; or it is in the position of accusative for blame (dhamm), being the object of an omitted verb, implied as "I blame". The clause ﴿يبخلون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿يأمرون الناس﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يبخلون﴾; and ﴿بالبخل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأمرون﴾.
﴿ويكتمون ما آتاهم الله من فضله﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; يكتمون is conjoined to يبخلون, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ما﴾ is its object; the clause ﴿آتاهم الله﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من فضله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتاهم﴾.
﴿وأعتدنا للكافرين عذابا مهينا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; أعتدنا is a verb and its fāʿil; للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعتدنا﴾; عذابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and مهينًا a ṣifa (adjective); and the clause ﴿وأعتدنا للكافرين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿وما كان لمؤمن أن يقتل مؤمنا إلا خطأ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; «كان» is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿لمؤمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يقتل مؤمنًا﴾ is the postponed noun of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «خطأ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "erring"; or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "except by error"; or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is the qualifier of the maṣdar, i.e. "a killing in error"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "it is not proper for him to kill him for any reason whatsoever except for error alone".
﴿ومن قتل مؤمنا خطأ فتحرير رقبة مؤمنة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «قتل» is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «مؤمنًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فتحرير﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «تحرير» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "then upon him is the freeing of a slave", or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then what is obligatory is the freeing of a slave"; «مؤمنة» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رقبة»; the nominal clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «مَن».
﴿ودية مسلمة إلى أهله إلا أن يصدقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «دية» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تحرير رقبة﴾; «مسلمة» is a naʿt; ﴿إلى أهله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مسلّمة»; ﴿إلا أن يصدقوا﴾ is an exception from the most general of states, i.e. "except in the state of giving it in charity", so it is a ḥāl; or from the most general of times, i.e. "when they give it in charity", so it is an adverb attached to «مسلّمة»; or it is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ).
﴿فإن كان من قوم عدو لكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is a jussive conditional particle; «كان» is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the noun of «كان» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; ﴿من قوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; «عدو» is a naʿt of «قوم»; and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of «عدو».
﴿وهو مؤمن فتحرير رقبة مؤمنة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هو» is mubtadaʾ and «مؤمن» khabar, and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; «تحرير» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "then upon him is the freeing of a slave", or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then what is obligatory is the freeing of a slave"; «مؤمنة» is a naʿt of «رقبة»; and the clause ﴿فإن كان من قوم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن كان من قوم بينكم وبينهم ميثاق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; ﴿من قوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; ﴿بينكم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿وبينهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بينكم﴾; and «ميثاق» is a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿فدية مسلمة إلى أهله﴾: the fāʾ is connective; «دية» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "then upon him is blood-money", or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then what is obligatory upon him is blood-money"; «مسلّمة» is a naʿt; and ﴿إلى أهله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مسلمة».
﴿وتحرير رقبة مؤمنة﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; ﴿لم يجد﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; «صيام» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿فصيام﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; «شهرين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «متتابعين» is a naʿt; and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of «مَن».
﴿توبة من الله وكان الله عليما حكيما﴾: «توبة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. "He legislated that for you as a mercy from Him and a turning [in forgiveness]", or a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "He turned to you in forgiveness with a turning"; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt; the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «عليمًا حكيمًا» are its two khabars; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ومن يقتل مؤمنا متعمدا فجزاؤه جهنم خالدا فيها﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يقتل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «مؤمنًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «متعمدًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿فجزاؤه﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), «جزاؤه» is mubtadaʾ and «جهنم» its khabar (predicate); the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «مَن»; «خالدًا» is a ḥāl; and «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدًا﴾.
﴿وغضب الله عليه ولعنه﴾: the wāw conjoins to something implied which the conditional [sentence] indicates, i.e. "Allah has judged that his recompense is that, and He is angry with him".
﴿وأعد له عذابا عظيما﴾: also conjoined (maʿṭūf).

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا ضربتم في سبيل الله فتبينوا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿ضربتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿في سبيل﴾ الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ضربتم»; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis of ﴿إذا﴾; «تبينوا» is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ولا تقولوا لمن ألقى إليكم السلام لست مؤمنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تقولوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقولوا﴾; the clause «ألقى إليكم السلام» is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position; ﴿إليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقى﴾; «السلام» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لست مؤمنًا﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and «مؤمنًا» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ليس﴾.
﴿تبتغون عرض الحياة الدنيا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿تقولوا﴾, i.e. "do not say those words while seeking booty".
﴿فعند الله مغانم كثيرة﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for the prohibition, and the clause has no grammatical position; ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «مغانم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and «كثيرة» is a naʿt.
﴿كذلك كنتم من قبل فمن الله عليكم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the fronted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; in «ذلك», ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿كنتم﴾: «كان» is an abrogating verb, the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; in «فـ﴿منَّ﴾» the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿منَّ الله﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿كنتم﴾; and «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿منَّ﴾.
﴿فتبينوا إن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to the first ﴿تبينوا﴾, the command to verify being repeated for emphasis; or the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you have come to know this and grasped its consequences, then verify"; ﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty is its noun; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; «خبيرًا» is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause of «كان» and what follows it is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾, and the clause is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما»; and ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبيرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿لا يستوي القاعدون من المؤمنين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; «يستوي» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the ḍamma being implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; «القاعدون» is its fāʿil (agent); and «من المؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿القاعدون﴾.
﴿غير أولي الضرر والمجاهدون في سبيل الله بأموالهم وأنفسهم﴾: ﴿غير﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿القاعدون﴾, or a naʿt (adjective), or accusative as an exception; the first is preferable, as is established in the books of grammar, because the speech is negated; ﴿أولي الضرر﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; «المجاهدون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿القاعدون﴾; ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿المجاهدون﴾; «بأموالهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to it; and «أنفسهم» is conjoined to ﴿بأموالهم﴾.
﴿فضل الله المجاهدين بأموالهم وأنفسهم على القاعدين درجة﴾: ﴿فضَّل الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil. «المجاهدين»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; the clause ﴿فضل الله المجاهدين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «بأموالهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿المجاهدين﴾. «أنفسهم»: conjoined to «أموالهم». «على القاعدين»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فضل﴾. «درجة»: accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "by a degree"; or an accusative substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because ﴿درجة﴾ contains the meaning of preferring, the implied form being "He preferred them with one preference"; or an accusative ḥāl from «المجاهدين», i.e. "possessors of a degree"; or an accusative tamyīz (specification); or an adverb, i.e. "in degree and rank".
﴿وكلا وعد الله الحسنى﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); «كلّا» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿وعد﴾; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; «الحسنى» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿وكلا...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is parenthetical.
﴿وفضل الله المجاهدين على القاعدين أجرا عظيما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to what preceded; «أجرًا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq because it carries the meaning of preferring; or a second object of ﴿فضل﴾, on the view that the verb «فضَّل» contains the meaning of «أعطى» ("gave"), i.e. "He gave them, over and above those who sit, a great reward"; or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "He preferred them with a great reward"; «عظيمًا»: a naʿt of ﴿أجرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿درجات منه ومغفرة ورحمة﴾: «درجات» is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أجرًا﴾; «منه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «درجات». ﴿ومغفرة ورحمة﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «درجات», or [each is] a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) with its verb implied, meaning: "and He forgave them with forgiveness and had mercy on them with mercy".
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «غفورًا رحيمًا» are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿إن الذين توفاهم الملائكة ظالمي أنفسهم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters) and «الذين» is its noun; the clause ﴿توفاهم الملائكة﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause); or a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; «الملائكة» is the fāʿil (agent); «ظالمي أنفسهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾ is omitted, its implied form being "those whom the angels take in death [are] perished", or it is His saying ﴿قالوا فيم كنتم﴾, or ﴿فأولئك مأواهم جهنم﴾, the fāʾ entering the khabar as a link (ṣila), the relative being likened to a conditional noun.
[Translator's note: the phrase "or a past verb indeclinable on an implied fatḥa" stands as written; it evidently refers to «توفى», the alternative (that it is an imperfect with one tāʾ dropped) not being stated.]
﴿قالوا فيم كنتم﴾: the pronoun in ﴿قالوا﴾ refers back to the angels; the clause is the khabar, or resumptive with no grammatical position, explaining the omitted clause; ﴿فيم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قالوا كنا مستضعفين في الأرض﴾: the pronoun in ﴿قالوا﴾ refers back to ﴿الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة﴾; the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿كنا مستضعفين في الأرض﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying; «مستضعفين» is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مستضعفين».
[Translator's note: the source quotes «تتوفاهم» here, whereas the ayah reads «توفاهم».]
﴿قالوا ألم تكن أرض الله واسعة فتهاجروا فيها﴾: the pronoun in ﴿قالوا﴾ refers back to the angels, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the hamza is interrogative; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, inversion [to past meaning] and jussive; «تكن» is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; «أرض الله» is the noun of «تكن» and «واسعة» its khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying; the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya); «تهاجروا» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the causal fāʾ; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, the implied form being "Was there not spaciousness in the earth, and so an emigration on your part?"; the wāw is the fāʿil; and «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تهاجروا».
﴿فأولئك مأواهم جهنم﴾: the fāʾ is connective because of the scent of condition in the relative; «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «مأواهم» is a mubtadaʾ; «جهنم» is the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; and the clause ﴿فأولئك...﴾ is the khabar of ﴿إن الذين﴾, or a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وساءت مصيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ساءت» is a past verb of blame; «مصيرًا» is a tamyīz (specification); the specified object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "Hell"; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿والذين ينفقون أموالهم رئاء الناس﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding الذين; the clause ينفقون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أموالهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رئاء الناس is an interpreted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e., "showing off", or a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e., "so that it be said: how generous they are!".
﴿ولا يؤمنون بالله ولا باليوم الآخر﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ومن يكن الشيطان له قرينا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; مَن is conditional and the mubtadaʾ (subject); يكن is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl; and قرينًا is the khabar (predicate) of يكن.
﴿فساء قرينا﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa". قرينًا: a tamyīz (specification), accusative, and the one specified for blame is omitted, implied as ﴿هو﴾, referring back to ﴿الشيطان﴾. The clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يكن الشيطان...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وماذا عليهم لو آمنوا بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ماذا: ما is interrogative, in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ذا is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate) of ما; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. Or ﴿ماذا﴾ as a whole is an interrogative noun and the mubtadaʾ, and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. لو is conditional; آمنوا is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the apodosis is omitted, the implied meaning being: "then what harm would that do them?" Or ﴿لو﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿لو﴾ and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e., "and what [harm] is there for them in their believing?" بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا; اليوم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty; and الآخر is a ṣifa (adjective).
﴿وأنفقوا مما رزقهم الله﴾: Conjoined to آمنوا; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنفقوا; and the clause ﴿رزقهم الله﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وماذا عليهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان الله بهم عليما﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليمًا﴾; عليمًا is the khabar of كان; and the clause ﴿وكان الله بهم عليما﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إن الله لا يظلم مثقال ذرة﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause لا يظلم is its khabar (predicate); and مثقال ذرة is a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e., "a wrong of an atom's weight". Or ﴿يظلم﴾ has been made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of a verb that takes two objects, so ﴿مثقال﴾ is accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being omitted, the implied meaning being: "He does not diminish, or does not defraud, anyone an atom's weight".
﴿وإن تك حسنة يضاعفها﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تك is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied on the nūn that has been dropped from the jussive imperfect of ﴿كان﴾ for lightening; its noun is latent (mustatir), referring back to the مثقال (weight); حسنة is the khabar of ﴿تك﴾; يضاعفها is the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويؤت من لدنه أجرا عظيما﴾: ﴿ويؤت﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يضاعفها﴾; من لدنه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤت﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) because it precedes the noun it qualifies; أجرًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and عظيمًا is a ṣifa.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿فكيف إذا جئنا من كل أمة بشهيد﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e., "and how will their state be?", or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from something omitted, i.e., "how will they fare?"; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) this omitted [element]; the clause ﴿جئنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿من كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿بشهيد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جئنا; or ﴿كيف﴾ is governed by جئنا. The clause ﴿فكيف إذا جئنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
