﴿وجئنا بك على هؤلاء شهيدا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; جئنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and both are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿جئنا﴾; لك [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is ﴿بك﴾] is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جئنا﴾; على هؤلاء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾; and شهيدًا is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿يومئذ يود الذين كفروا﴾: ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يودّ﴾; إذٍ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn that is implied because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of substitution, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn is a substitute for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "On the day when We bring from every nation a witness and bring you as a witness against these, those who disbelieved will wish". The clause ﴿يود﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعصوا الرسول لو تسوى بهم الأرض﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿عصوا الرسول﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿كفروا﴾; ﴿لو﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يود﴾, i.e., "they will wish for the earth to be levelled over them, so that they are buried in it"; and الأرض is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of تسوى.
﴿ولا يكتمون الله حديثا﴾: Conjoined to ﴿يود﴾, or for resumption, the clause being resumptive with no grammatical position; يكتمون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the Name of Majesty is accusative by removal of the preposition, and حديثًا is the mafʿūl bihi, i.e., "they will not conceal from Allah any statement"; or the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi of يكتمون.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تقربوا الصلاة وأنتم سكارى﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; تقربوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and سكارى its khabar (predicate).
﴿حتى تعلموا ما تقولون﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; تعلموا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after ﴿حتى﴾, and أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقربوا; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar from maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا جنبا إلا عابري سبيل حتى تغتسلوا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His words ﴿وأنتم سكارى﴾, which is a clause whose position is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿تقربوا﴾; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿عابري سبيل﴾ is an exception from the general states of those addressed, so it is accusative as a ḥāl; ﴿حتى تغتسلوا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition, تغتسلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after ﴿حتى﴾, and أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقربوا.
﴿وإن كنتم مرضى أو على سفر﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾: كان is an incomplete past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), the tāʾ is its noun, and مرضى its khabar; أو is a conjunction; and ﴿على سفر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to ﴿مرضى﴾.
﴿أو جاء أحد منكم من الغائط﴾: أو is a conjunction; جاء is conjoined to what preceded; أحد is the fāʿil; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of أحد; and ﴿من الغائط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاء.
﴿أو لامستم النساء﴾: Also conjoined.
﴿فلم تجدوا ماء﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿كنتم﴾.
﴿فتيمموا صعيدا طيبا﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); تيمموا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; صعيدًا is the mafʿūl bihi and طيبًا a ṣifa; and the clause ﴿فتيمموا﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿فامسحوا بوجوهكم وأيديكم﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; امسحوا is conjoined to ﴿تيمموا﴾; ﴿بوجوهكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿امسحوا﴾; أيديكم is conjoined to وجوهكم; or the bāʾ is partitive (tabʿīḍ).
﴿إن الله كان عفوا غفورا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and عفوا غفورا are its two predicates, [the clause being] in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين أوتوا نصيبا من الكتاب﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); نصيبًا is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿نصيبًا﴾.
﴿يشترون الضلالة ويريدون أن تضلوا السبيل﴾: The clause ﴿يشترون﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تر﴾ if it is [a verb of] the heart (i.e., mental perception), and a ḥāl (circumstantial) if it is visual; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الضلالة is the mafʿūl bihi; يريدون is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يشترون﴾; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and what is in its domain is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يريدون﴾; and السبيل is the object of ﴿تضلوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿والله أعلم بأعدائكم﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أعلم is the khabar (predicate); بأعدائكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وكفى بالله وليا وكفى بالله نصيرا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كفى is a past verb; ﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) preposition, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) of كفى, genitive in form because of the bāʾ; وليًّا and نصيرًا are two tamyīz (specification), or two ḥāls; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿من الذين هادوا يحرفون الكلم﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "Among those who are Jews are people who distort the words", and the clause ﴿يحرفون﴾ is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, which is the mubtadaʾ. Or ﴿من الذين هادوا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: "they are among those who are Jews", and the clause ﴿يحرفون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of ﴿هادوا﴾.
﴿عن مواضعه﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحرفون.
﴿ويقولون سمعنا وعصينا﴾: The clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يحرفون﴾; the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); and the clause ﴿وعصينا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾.
﴿واسمع غير مسمع﴾: Conjoined to ﴿سمعنا﴾, and ﴿غير مسمع﴾ is a ḥāl from the one addressed.
﴿وراعنا﴾: Conjoined to what is before it.
﴿ليا بألسنتهم وطعنا في الدين﴾: ﴿ليًّا﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and what puts it in the accusative is the verb ﴿يقولون﴾; or: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e., "twisting and attacking". ﴿بألسنتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ليا﴾; ﴿وطعنًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليًّا﴾; and ﴿في الدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طعنًا﴾.
﴿ولو أنهم قالوا سمعنا وأطعنا﴾: The wāw is circumstantial or resumptive, and the clause is circumstantial, or resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; أنّ with what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e., "if their saying had been established"; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the khabar of أنّ; and the two clauses ﴿سمعنا وأطعنا﴾ are part of the maqūl al-qawl.
﴿واسمع وانظرنا﴾: Conjoined to what is said.
﴿لكان خيرا لهم وأقوم﴾: The lām is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لو﴾; كان is an incomplete past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), implied as "huwa" (it), and خيرًا is its khabar; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾; and أقوم is conjoined to ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿ولكن لعنهم الله بكفرهم فلا يؤمنون إلا قليلا﴾: The wāw is circumstantial; ﴿لكن﴾ is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative; ﴿لعنهم الله﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and قليلًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e., "except with little belief", or excepted from the wāw in يؤمنون, i.e., "a few of them".

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿إلا المستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدان﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception; «المستضعفين» is the excepted (mustathnā), and the exception is connected (muttaṣil) or disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); «من الرجال» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «النساء» and «الولدان» are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الرجال».
﴿لا يستطيعون حيلة ولا يهتدون سبيلا﴾: the clause ﴿لا يستطيعون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of «المستضعفين», the ﴿ال﴾ in it being generic (jinsiyya); or a ḥāl from ﴿المستضعفين﴾ or from the pronoun latent in it. «حيلة» is the object of «يستطيعون»; the clause ﴿ولا يهتدون﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يستطيعون﴾; and «سبيلًا» is the object of «يهتدون», or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "to any one of the various ways".
[Translator's note: the source prints «الحافض» for «الخافض» (the preposition) here.]

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿فأولئك عسى الله أن يعفو عنهم﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, because it occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, i.e. "if you want to know their fate"; «أولئك» is mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عسى﴾ is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, one of the verbs of hope; the Name of Majesty is the noun of ﴿عسى﴾; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يعفو﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and the verbal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿وكان الله عفوا غفورا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «عفوًّا غفورًا» are its two khabars; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿ومن يهاجر في سبيل الله يجد في الأرض مراغما كثيرا وسعة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يهاجر» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «في سبيل الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يهاجر»; «يجد» is an imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾; «مراغمًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «كثيرًا» is a naʿt (adjective); «سعة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿مراغمًا﴾; and the entire conditional sentence ﴿ومن يهاجر في سبيل الله يجد...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يخرج من بيته مهاجرا إلى الله ورسوله ثم يدركه الموت فقد وقع أجره على الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; «يخرج» is an imperfect verb, the protasis; «من بيته» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخرج»; «مهاجرًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿إلى الله ورسوله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مهاجرًا﴾; ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction; «يدركه» is conjoined to ﴿يخرجْ﴾, the hāʾ being mafʿūl bihi and «الموت» the fāʿil (agent) of «يدركه»; ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis and «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the clause ﴿وقع أجره على الله﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «وقع»; and the entire conditional sentence ﴿من يخرج من بيته مهاجرا...﴾ is conjoined to the preceding conditional sentence.
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «غفورا رحيما» are its two khabars; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿وإذا ضربتم في الأرض فليس عليكم جناح﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿ضربتم في الأرض﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿إذا﴾; ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ليس﴾; «جناح» is its postponed noun; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿أن تقصروا من الصلاة﴾: «أن» is maṣdariyya; «تقصروا» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by «أن», and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن تقصروا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in shortening the prayer", the preposition and its genitive noun being a naʿt (adjective) of «جناح»; and ﴿من الصلاة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقصروا﴾.
﴿إن خفتم أن يفتنكم الذين كفروا﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «خفتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «خفتم»; «الذين كفروا» is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; the conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then there is no blame on you in shortening".
﴿إن الكافرين كانوا لكم عدوا مبينا﴾: the clause gives the reason for the permission to shorten mentioned above; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), «الكافرين» its noun, and the clause «كانوا» its khabar; the wāw is the noun of «كان»; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «عدوًّا» is the khabar of «كان»; and «مبينًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿وإذا كنت فيهم فأقمت لهم الصلاة﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction and the speech is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿كنت﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; the tāʾ is the noun of «كان»; ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان», the pronoun referring back to those travelling in the land, or to those who fear; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أقمت» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أقمت»; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿كنت﴾; and «الصلاة» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فلتقم طائفة منهم معك﴾: the fāʾ is connective; the lām is the lām of command; «تقم» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; «طائفة» is the fāʿil; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); and «معك» is an adverb of place attached to «تقم».
﴿وليأخذوا أسلحتهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ليأخذوا» is conjoined to ﴿فلتقم﴾; and «أسلحتهم» is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإذا سجدوا فليكونوا من ورائكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿سجدوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿فليكونوا﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «يكونوا» is a defective imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun; and «من ورائكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «يكون».
﴿ولتأت طائفة أخرى لم يصلوا فليصلوا معك﴾: also conjoined; the clause ﴿لم يصلوا﴾ is a second naʿt of «طائفة»; «فليصلوا» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and «معك» is an adverb of place attached to ﴿فليصلوا﴾.
﴿وليأخذوا حذرهم وأسلحتهم﴾: also conjoined.
﴿ود الذين كفروا لو تغفلون عن أسلحتكم وأمتعتكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «ود الذين» is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with what follows it as an accusative maṣdar (verbal noun), because it is the object of «تود»; the clause ﴿تغفلون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative; «عن أسلحتكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تغفلون»; and «أمتعتكم» is conjoined to «أسلحتكم».
[Translator's note: the source writes «تود» here, whereas the verb in the ayah is «ودّ».]
﴿فيميلون عليكم ميلة واحدة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «يميلون»: conjoined to «تغفلون»; «عليكم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يميلون﴾; «ميلة»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «واحدة»: a naʿt.
﴿ولا جناح عليكم إن كان بكم أذى من مطر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation, and «جناح» is its noun; «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿لا﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «كان» is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of «كان»; «أذى» is its postponed noun; «من مطر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of «أذى»; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then there is no blame on you".
﴿أو كنتم مرضى أن تضعوا أسلحتكم﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; «كنتم» is conjoined to ﴿كان بكم أذى﴾; «مرضى» is the khabar of «كان»; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تضعوا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in that you lay down", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «جناح», or to an omitted naʿt of it; and «أسلحتكم» is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وخذوا حذركم﴾: also conjoined.
﴿إن الله أعد للكافرين عذابا مهينا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «أعد للكافرين» is its khabar; «عذابًا» is the object of «أعد»; and «مهينًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿فإذا قضيتم الصلاة فاذكروا الله قياما وقعودا وعلى جنوبكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿قضيتم الصلاة﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; the fāʾ is connective; the clause ﴿اذكروا الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «قيامًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), «قعودًا» a second ḥāl, and «على جنوبكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted third ḥāl by way of conjunction.
﴿فإذا اطمأننتم فأقيموا الصلاة﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿إن الصلاة كانت على المؤمنين كتابا موقوتا﴾: the clause gives the reason for what preceded; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), «الصلاة» its noun, and the clause ﴿كانت﴾ the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «كانت» is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿على المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿موقوتًا﴾; «كتابًا» is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and «موقوتًا» is a naʿt (adjective), i.e. "delimited by times".

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿ولا تهنوا في ابتغاء القوم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تهنوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; and «في ابتغاء القوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تهنوا».
﴿إن تكونوا تألمون فإنهم يألمون كما تألمون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is a jussive conditional particle; «تكونوا» is a defective imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the noun of «كان», and the clause ﴿تألمون﴾ its khabar (predicate); the conditional clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for the prohibition; «فإنهم»: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يألمون﴾ is its khabar; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; ﴿كما تألمون﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "they suffer a suffering like your suffering"; «ما» is maṣdariyya; «تألمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تألمون﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿تألمون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وترجون من الله ما لا يرجون﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ﴿يألمون﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «ترجون»; and the clause ﴿لا يرجون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وكان الله عليما حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «عليما حكيما» are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause «أنزلنا» is its khabar (predicate); «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا»; «الكتاب» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لتحكم بين الناس بما أراك الله﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); «تحكم» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied «أن» and the verb ﴿تحكم﴾ is genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «أنزلنا»; ﴿بين الناس﴾ is an adverb attached to «تحكم»; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تحكم»; the clause ﴿أراك الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; the seeing is mental (qalbiyya), so the kāf is the first object, and the second is omitted, it being the omitted returning pronoun, i.e. "by what Allah has shown you [it]" (بما أراكه الله).
﴿ولا تكن للخائنين خصيما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تكن» is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; «للخائنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خصيمًا﴾; and «خصيما» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; أوتوا is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); الكتاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ الكتاب is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿آمنوا بما نزلنا مصدقا لما معكم﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. آمنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنوا﴾; the clause ﴿نزلنا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; مصدقًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; and ﴿معكم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, i.e., "confirming that which is established with you", and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿من قبل أن نطمس وجوها فنردها على أدبارها﴾: ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن نطمس﴾ is genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); وجوهًا is the mafʿūl bihi; فنردها: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and نردها is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نطمس﴾, accusative like it, and ﴿ها﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿على أدبارها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [element] in the place of the second object of نردها, or to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أو نلعنهم كما لعنا أصحاب السبت﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; نلعنهم is conjoined to ﴿نطمس وجوهًا﴾ or to ﴿نردها﴾; ﴿كما لعنا﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ṣifa of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e., "We curse them with a cursing like Our cursing of the people of the Sabbath"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿لعنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿لعن﴾; the clause ﴿لعنا﴾ is the ṣila of maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿لعنا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أصحاب﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿السبت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وكان أمر الله مفعولا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); أمر is its noun and مفعولا its khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿إن الله لا يغفر أن يشرك به﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يغفر﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and what is in its domain is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يغفر﴾, or accusative by removal of the preposition; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشرك﴾.
﴿ويغفر ما دون ذلك لمن يشاء﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and يغفر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the negated [verb], so it is affirmative; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. يغفر is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; دون is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿ذلك﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر; and the clause يشاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾.
﴿ومن يشرك بالله فقد افترى إثما عظيما﴾: The wāw is resumptive; مَن is conditional and the mubtadaʾ (subject); يشرك is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يشرك; ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); افترى is a past verb; إثمًا is the mafʿūl bihi and عظيمًا a ṣifa (adjective); the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of مَن; and the clause ﴿ومن يشرك بالله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين يزكون أنفسهم﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation expressing wonder; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; and the clause يزكون أنفسهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بل الله يزكي من يشاء﴾: ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يزكى﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the Quranic word is ﴿يزكي﴾] is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause يشاء is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يظلمون فتيلا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; يظلمون is an imperfect verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to something omitted, implied as: "so they are rewarded and are not wronged"; and فتيلًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e., "a wrong to the extent of a date-stone thread", or a second object, on the basis that يظلمون has been made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "they are deprived [of]".

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿انظر كيف يفترون على الله الكذب﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. انظر is an imperative verb; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); يفترون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of انظر; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفترون; and الكذب: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a description of the maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿وكفى به إثما مبينا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كفى is a verb; ﴿به﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) preposition, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun, in the position of genitive by the bāʾ in form, and in the position of nominative by implication (taqdīran) as the fāʿil of كفى. إثمًا: a tamyīz (specification), accusative. مبينًا: a naʿt (adjective), accusative. The clause ﴿كفى به إثما مبينا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين أوتوا نصيبا من الكتاب﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the clause أوتوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); نصيبًا is the second object of أوتوا; and من الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿نصيبًا﴾.
﴿يؤمنون بالجبت والطاغوت﴾: The clause يؤمنون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذين﴾, or from the wāw in أوتوا, or in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تر﴾ in the sense of knowing.
﴿ويقولون للذين كفروا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; يقولون is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقولون﴾; and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿هؤلاء أهدى من الذين آمنوا سبيلا﴾: The clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); هؤلاء is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أهدى its khabar (predicate); من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أهدى﴾; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and سبيلًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿أولئك الذين لعنهم الله﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; and the clause ﴿لعنهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يلعن الله فلن تجد له نصيرا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is conditional, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يلعن﴾; يلعن is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), jussive (majzūm), and it has been vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity; ﴿تجد﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by لن; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نصيرًا﴾; نصيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi of تجد; the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, although it has just parsed ﴿مَن﴾ as a fronted object rather than a mubtadaʾ]; and the clause ﴿ومن يلعن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿أم لهم نصيب من الملك﴾: ﴿أم﴾: a disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction meaning "rather" together with the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: "Rather, do they have a share?" The interrogation here is one of disapproval (inkārī). لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); نصيب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and من الملك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of نصيب.
﴿فإذا لا يؤتون الناس نقيرا﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ), because it discloses an implied condition, i.e., "if they were given a share of the dominion, then in that case..."; ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of answer and requital; لا is negating; يؤتون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الناس is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿نقيرًا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿أم يحسدون الناس على ما آتاهم الله من فضله﴾: ﴿أم﴾ is a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb) meaning "rather"; يحسدون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); الناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على ما آتاهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحسدون﴾; the clause ﴿آتاهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); and من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتاهم﴾.
﴿فقد آتينا آل إبراهيم الكتاب والحكمة﴾: The fāʾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿آل إبراهيم﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and الكتاب the second mafʿūl bihi; and الحكمة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الكتاب.
﴿وآتيناهم ملكا عظيما﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿فمنهم من آمن به﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive, for derivation (tafrīʿ); منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مَن is a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمن﴾.
﴿ومنهم من صد عنه﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿وكفى بجهنم سعيرا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; كفى is a past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) particle; جهنم is genitive by the bāʾ in form and nominative in position as the fāʿil (agent) of كفى; سعيرًا is a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿وكفى بجهنم سعيرا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا بآياتنا سوف نصليهم نارا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); الذين is its noun; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفروا; سوف is a particle of futurity; نصليهم is an imperfect verb, the hāʾ is its first object and نارًا its second object; the clause ﴿سوف نصليهم نارًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause of إن with what is in its domain is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كلما نضجت جلودهم بدلناهم جلودا غيرها﴾: The clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the accusative pronoun in ﴿نصليهم﴾, or a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿نارًا﴾, and an omitted returning pronoun must be supposed, i.e., "whenever their skins are roasted in it". ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ is a substitute for an adverb of time, attached to ﴿بدلناهم﴾, containing the meaning of condition, and ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿نضجت جلودهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾, and maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), with a muḍāf omitted, the implied form being: "every time of the roasting of their skins". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), and the returning pronoun is omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which their skins are roasted", so that the clause ﴿نضجت جلودهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as a ṣifa of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿نضجت﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿جلودهم﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿بدلناهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; بدلناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿جلودًا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition; and غيرها is a ṣifa of ﴿جلودًا﴾.
﴿ليذوقوا العذاب﴾: The lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl) and is a preposition; يذوقوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿بدلناهم﴾; the sign of its accusative is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and العذاب is its object.
﴿إن الله كان عزيزا حكيما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is its khabar; the noun of كان is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "huwa" (He); عزيزًا is the first khabar of كان, and حكيمًا its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿واستغفر الله﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿استغفر الله﴾ is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta".
﴿إن الله كان غفورا رحيما﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; «غفورا» is the first khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾ and «رحيما» its second khabar; and the clause ﴿كان غفورا رحيما﴾ is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿ولا تجادل عن الذين يختانون أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تجادل» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta"; «عن الذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجادل»; and the clause ﴿يختانون أنفسهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿إن الله لا يحب من كان خوانا أثيما﴾: the reason for the prohibition; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يحب﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position; ﴿خوانًا﴾ is the khabar of «كان» and «أثيمًا» a naʿt (adjective); or the two are two khabars of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿يستخفون من الناس ولا يستخفون من الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿مَن﴾, taking it as a relative; and the clause ﴿ولا يستخفون من الله﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first.
﴿وهو معهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هو» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the adverb ﴿معهم﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿إذ يبيتون ما لا يرضى من القول﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to the omitted khabar to which ﴿معهم﴾ is attached; it has also been said that it is attached to ﴿يستخفون﴾; the clause ﴿يبيتون﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لا يرضى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; and «من القول» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وكان الله بما يعملون محيطا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «محيطًا» its khabar; and ﴿بما يعملون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿محيطًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿ها أنتم هؤلاء جادلتم عنهم في الحياة الدنيا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); ﴿أنتم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هؤلاء﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿جادلتم﴾: in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a second khabar, or of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or ﴿أنتم﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿جادلتم﴾: khabar; and ﴿هؤلاء﴾: the one addressed (munādā), the vocative particle having been omitted from it, the vocative clause being parenthetical, with no grammatical position. «عنهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جادلتم﴾; «في الحياة»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and «الدنيا» is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿فمن يجادل الله عنهم يوم القيامة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿من﴾ is a noun of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يجادل الله﴾ is the khabar; «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يجادل»; and «يوم القيامة» is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أم من يكون عليهم وكيلا﴾: ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿من﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; «يكون» is a defective imperfect verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring back to ﴿مَن﴾; the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيلًا﴾; and «وكيلًا» is the khabar of «يكون».

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿ومن يعمل سوءا أو يظلم نفسه﴾: ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يعمل» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; «سوءًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; «يظلم نفسه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يعمل»; and «نفسه» is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ثم يستغفر الله يجد الله غفورا رحيما﴾: ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿يستغفر الله﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; ﴿يجد الله﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾; «غفورًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «رحيمًا» is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿ومن يعمل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿ومن يكسب إثما فإنما يكسبه على نفسه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يكسب» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; «إثما» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿فإنما﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; and «على نفسه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يكسبه».
﴿وكان الله عليما حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «عليمًا حكيمًا» are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿ومن يكسب خطيئة أو إثما﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يكسب» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; «خطيئة» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «أو إثما» is conjoined to «خطيئة».
﴿ثم يرم به بريئا﴾: conjoined to «يكسب»; the pronoun is made singular, giving predominance to «الإثم»; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرمِ﴾; and «بريئًا» is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فقد احتمل بهتانا وإثما مبينا﴾: the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿ولولا فضل الله عليك ورحمته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; ﴿لولا﴾ is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), containing the meaning of a condition; ﴿فضل الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; «عليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فضل»; and «رحمته» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «فضل».
﴿لهمت طائفة منهم أن يضلوك﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لولا﴾; the clause ﴿همت طائفة﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يضلوك﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «همت», i.e. "they were intent on misleading you". The clause ﴿ولولا فضل الله...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وما يضلون إلا أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is negative; «يضلون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «أنفسهم» is the object of «يضلون»; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما يضرونك من شيء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; «يضرونك» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined to «يضلون»; ﴿من﴾ is a linking (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and «شيء» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), genitive in form and accusative in position, i.e. "any harm at all".
﴿وأنزل الله عليك الكتاب والحكمة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, carrying the sense of a reason for what preceded; «الكتاب» is mafʿūl bihi; and «الحكمة» is conjoined to «الكتاب».
﴿وعلمك ما لم تكن تعلم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second object of «علمك»; the clause ﴿لم تكن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿تعلم﴾ is the khabar of «تكن».
﴿وكان فضل الله عليك عظيما﴾: also conjoined; «كان» is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), ﴿فضل الله﴾ is its noun, and «عظيمًا» its khabar; and «عليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فضل».

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿لا خير في كثير من نجواهم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation, and «خير» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; «في كثير» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and «من نجواهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «كثير».
﴿إلا من أمر بصدقة أو معروف أو إصلاح بين الناس﴾: ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, a badal (substitute) from ﴿كثير﴾ or from ﴿نجوى﴾, or accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), i.e. "but whoever enjoins charity, in his private counsel there is much good"; «بصدقة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أمر», and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; and «بين الناس» is an adverb of place attached to «إصلاح».
﴿ومن يفعل ذلك ابتغاء مرضات الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يفعل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «ذلك» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿ابتغاء مرضاة الله﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فسوف نؤتيه أجرا عظيما﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سوف» is a particle of futurity; «نؤتيه» is an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi; «أجرًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being ﴿نحن﴾; «عظيمًا» is a naʿt; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يفعل ذلك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿ومن يشاقق الرسول من بعد ما تبين له الهدى﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); «يشاقق» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الرسول» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يشاقق»; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya and, together with ﴿تبين﴾, is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by annexation; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تبين»; and «الهدى» is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ويتبع غير سبيل المؤمنين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يشاقق»; and ﴿غير سبيل المؤمنين﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿نوله ما تولى﴾: ﴿نوله﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is its first object; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, its second object; the clause ﴿تولى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿ونصله جهنم وساءت مصيرا﴾: conjoined to ﴿نوله﴾; «جهنم» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «نصله»; «مصيرًا» is accusative as a tamyīz (specification); and the specified object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "Hell".

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿إن الله لا يغفر أن يشرك به﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يغفر﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the object of «يغفر»; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشرك﴾.
﴿ويغفر ما دون ذلك لمن يشاء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يغفر» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa"; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «دون ذلك» is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila; «لمن يشاء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يغفر»; and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يشرك بالله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يشرك» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يشرك».
﴿فقد ضل ضلالا بعيدا﴾: the fāʾ is connective; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ضلالًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and «بعيدًا» a naʿt (adjective); and the clause of the condition and apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الذين كفروا﴾; الذين is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿سندخلهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: The clause ﴿سندخلهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جنات is the second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of جنات; خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين; and ﴿أبدًا﴾ is an adverb, also attached to خالدين.
﴿لهم فيها أزواج مطهرة﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; أزواج is a postponed mubtadaʾ; مطهرة is a ṣifa; and the nominal clause is a second ṣifa of جنات.
﴿وندخلهم ظلا ظليلا﴾: The clause is conjoined; ظلًّا is the second mafʿūl bihi by extension, the first object being the hāʾ; and ظليلًا is a ṣifa.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿إن الله يأمركم أن تؤدوا الأمانات إلى أهلها﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿يأمركم﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أنْ and what is in its domain is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e., "[commands you] to render", and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأمركم; or it is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يأمركم﴾; الأمانات is the mafʿūl bihi of تؤدوا, the sign of its accusative being the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; and إلى أهلها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تؤدوا.
﴿وإذا حكمتم بين الناس أن تحكموا بالعدل﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to something omitted, because what comes after maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾ does not govern what precedes it, the implied [verb] being: يأمركم (He commands you); the clause ﴿حكمتم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿بين الناس﴾ is an adverb attached to حكمتم; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تحكموا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أن تؤدوا﴾; and بالعدل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحكموا﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تحكموا, i.e., "clothed in justice".
﴿إن الله نعما يعظكم به﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. نعما is originally نعم and ما; ﴿نعم﴾ is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; ﴿ما﴾ is a complete indefinite noun, accusative as a tamyīz (specification), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), specified by an indefinite noun; or ﴿ما﴾ is relative and is thus the fāʿil of ﴿نعم﴾. The clause ﴿يعظكم به﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of the one specified for praise, which is omitted, the implied form being: "excellent is the thing as a thing with which He admonishes you", the qualified noun having been omitted; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعظكم; and the clause ﴿نعما﴾ is the khabar of إن.
﴿إن الله كان سميعا بصيرا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause كان is its khabar; ﴿سميعًا﴾ is the first khabar of كان and ﴿بصيرًا﴾ its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول وأولي الأمر منكم﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿أطيعوا الله﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأطيعوا الرسول﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أطيعوا الله﴾; أولي الأمر is also conjoined, and ﴿أولي﴾ is accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فإن تنازعتم في شيء فردوه إلى الله والرسول﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; تنازعتم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); في شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تنازعتم; فردوه: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis), and ردوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ردوه; ﴿الرسول﴾ is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن تنازعتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كنتم تؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is the incomplete كان, the tāʾ is its noun, and the past verb is in the position of jussive as the protasis; the clause ﴿تؤمنون﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كنتم﴾; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمنون﴾; اليوم is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, and الآخر is a ṣifa; the conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the apodosis is omitted, i.e., "then refer it".
﴿ذلك خير وأحسن تأويلا﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); خير is the khabar; أحسن is conjoined to خير; تأويلًا is a tamyīz (specification); and the reference is to the referring [back].

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين يزعمون أنهم آمنوا بما أنزل إليك﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation expressing wonder; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "anta" (you); إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾, the verb of seeing having been suspended (taʿlīq); the clause يزعمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أنهم: أنّ is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and أنّ with its noun [and khabar] has taken the place of the two objects of ﴿يزعمون﴾; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾; أنزل is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل.
﴿وما أنزل من قبلك﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ﴿ما﴾; the clause أنزل is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and من قبلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يريدون أن يتحاكموا إلى الطاغوت﴾: The clause ﴿يريدون﴾ is circumstantial; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and what is in its domain is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يريدون; and ﴿إلى الطاغوت﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتحاكموا.
﴿وقد أمروا أن يكفروا به﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); أمروا is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يكفروا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفروا.
﴿ويريد الشيطان أن يضلهم ضلالا بعيدا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ويريد الشيطان﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يريدون﴾; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يضلهم﴾ is the object of ﴿يريد﴾; ﴿ضلالًا﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and بعيدًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإذا قيل لهم تعالوا إلى ما أنزل الله وإلى الرسول﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, which is رأيت; the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause تعالوا is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); إلى ما أنزل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعالوا; the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and ﴿وإلى الرسول﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His words ﴿إلى ما أنزل الله﴾.
﴿رأيت المنافقين يصدون عنك صدودا﴾: رأيت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; المنافقين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يصدون﴾ is circumstantial if the seeing is visual, or a second object if the seeing is of the heart (mental); ﴿عنك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصدون﴾; and صدودًا: either it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), which is when the verb ﴿يصدون﴾ is transitive, the meaning being "they prevent others from you"; or it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) substituting for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, which is when the verb ﴿يصدون﴾ is intransitive, the meaning being "they hold back from you".

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿فكيف إذا أصابتهم مصيبة بما قدمت أيديهم﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e., "so how will they act?" or "so how will you see them?"; or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e., "so how will their conduct, or their state, be?" ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted apodosis; the clause ﴿أصابتهم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); مصيبة is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أصابتهم; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, or relative; the clause ﴿قدمت أيديهم﴾ has no grammatical position; and أيديهم is the fāʿil. The clause ﴿فكيف إذا أصابتهم مصيبة﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم جاءوك يحلفون بالله إن أردنا إلا إحسانا وتوفيقا﴾: ﴿ثم جاءوك﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أصابتهم; the clause ﴿يحلفون بالله﴾ is circumstantial; ﴿إن﴾ is negating; أردنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); إحسانًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and توفيقًا is conjoined to ﴿إحسانًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿أولئك الذين يعلم الله ما في قلوبهم﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; the clause ﴿يعلم الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿في قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فأعرض عنهم وعظهم وقل لهم في أنفسهم قولا بليغا﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, which discloses an implied condition, i.e., "if their state is like that, then turn away from them and accept no excuse from them"; أعرض is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (you); عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعرض; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an omitted non-jussive condition; عظهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أعرض﴾; قل لهم: conjoined to ﴿أعرض﴾, and ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قل﴾; في أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بليغًا﴾, or to ﴿قل﴾, i.e., "say to them, concerning their wicked souls and their hearts harbouring evil, an effective word", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e., "while what is said is in private, not going beyond their own selves". قولًا: the mafʿūl bihi, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative with fatḥa. بليغًا: a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من رسول﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ما is negating; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); مِن is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) preposition; and رسول is genitive in form and accusative in position as the object of أرسلنا.
﴿إلا ليطاع بإذن الله﴾: ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); يطاع is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of reasons, i.e., "We sent no messenger for any purpose whatsoever except for obedience", so it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), but it has not fulfilled the conditions for the accusative; and بإذن الله, the preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to أرسلنا, or attached to يطاع. The clause ﴿وما أرسلنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولو أنهم إذ ظلموا أنفسهم جاءوك﴾: The wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to جاءوك; the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause ﴿جاءوك﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "and if their coming had been established".
﴿فاستغفروا الله واستغفر لهم الرسول﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause ﴿استغفروا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿جاءوك﴾, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿واستغفر لهم الرسول﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.
﴿لوجدوا الله توابا رحيما﴾: The lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; ﴿وجدوا الله﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; توابًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; رحيمًا is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿توابًا﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it; and the clause ﴿ولو أنهم إذ جاءوك﴾ [Translator's note: so quoted in the source; the ayah reads ﴿ولو أنهم إذ ظلموا أنفسهم جاءوك﴾] is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿فلا وربك لا يؤمنون﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿لا﴾ is a connective [particle] (ṣila) for emphasizing the oath; the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb], implied as "I swear"; لا يؤمنون: لا is negating, يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; and the clause ﴿فلا وربك لا يؤمنون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى يحكموك فيما شجر بينهم﴾: ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and a preposition; يحكموك is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after ﴿حتى﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمنون; ﴿فيما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحكّموك; the clause ﴿شجر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and بينهم is an adverb of place attached to شجر.
﴿ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); لا is negating; يجدوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يحكموك; في أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجدوا, so it stands in place of the second object; حرجًا is the first mafʿūl bihi of يجدوا; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿حرجًا﴾; and the clause قضيت is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويسلموا تسليما﴾: Conjoined to يجدوا, and تسليمًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ولو أنا كتبنا عليهم أن اقتلوا أنفسكم﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; أنّ with what is in its domain is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e., "if Our prescribing had been established"; أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿كتبنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كتبنا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن اقتلوا﴾ is the object of ﴿كتبنا﴾. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. اقتلوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. أنفسكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أو اخرجوا من دياركم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اقتلوا أنفسكم, and من دياركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اخرجوا.
﴿ما فعلوه إلا قليل منهم﴾: The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the pronoun in ﴿فعلوه﴾ refers to one of the two commands, or to what was prescribed for them; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), or a badal (substitute) from the wāw in ﴿فعلوه﴾, because it is an exception from a complete, non-affirmative statement [Translator's note: so in the source; the word قليل has evidently dropped out, i.e., "and قليل is a badal from the wāw in ﴿فعلوه﴾"]; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of قليل. The clause ﴿ولو أنا كتبنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولو أنهم فعلوا ما يوعظون به﴾: Conjoined to what preceded; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; أنهم: أنّ is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; فعلوا: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يوعظون به﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فعلوا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ; and the interpreted maṣdar from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is the fāʿil of an implied verb, i.e., "and if their doing what they are admonished with had been established".
﴿لكان خيرا لهم وأشد تثبيتا﴾: The lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and خيرًا is its khabar; أشد is conjoined to ﴿خيرًا﴾; and تثبيتًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿إن يدعون من دونه إلا إناثا﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; «إن» is negative; «يدعون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); «من دونه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يدعون»; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and «إناثًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "feminine idols".
﴿وإن يدعون إلا شيطانا مريدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is negative; «يدعون» is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction; «شيطانًا» is mafʿūl bihi; and «مريدًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t: ﴿لعنه الله وقال لأتخذن من عبادك نصيبا مفروضا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is a supplication (duʿāʾiyya), or resumptive; or it is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شيطانًا﴾ in the preceding ayah; ﴿لعنه الله﴾ is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿وقال﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) with ﴿قد﴾ implied; the oath clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «أتخذن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the clause «أتخذن» has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to an omitted oath; «من عبادك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتخذن»; «نصيبًا» is mafʿūl bihi; «مفروضًا» is a naʿt; and the clause ﴿وقال لأتخذن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿ولأضلنهم ولأمنينهم ولآمرنهم﴾: the three clauses are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أتخذن».
﴿فليبتكن آذان الأنعام﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «آذان الأنعام» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولآمرنهم فليغيرن خلق الله﴾: also conjoined, and ﴿خلق الله﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ومن يتخذ الشيطان وليا من دون الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يتخذ» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «الشيطان» is the first mafʿūl bihi and «وليًّا» the second; and «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وليًّا﴾.
﴿فقد خسر خسرانا مبينا﴾: the fāʾ is connective; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «خسرانًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and «مبينًا» a naʿt; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يتخذ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿يعدهم ويمنيهم وما يعدهم الشيطان إلا غرورا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the [second] objects of «يعدهم» and «يمنيهم» are omitted, being known; ﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and ﴿ما﴾ is negative; «يعدهم الشيطان» is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and «غرورًا» is the second object of ﴿يعدهم﴾, or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it qualifies it, i.e. "a promise of delusion".

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿أولئك مأواهم جهنم﴾: «أولئك» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «مأواهم» is a second mubtadaʾ; «جهنم» is the khabar (predicate) of «مأواهم»; the nominal clause is the khabar of «أولئك»; and the clause ﴿أولئك مأواهم جهنم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يجدون عنها محيصا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; «يجدون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); «محيصًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «عنها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because a maṣdar (verbal noun) does not govern what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «الذين» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; and «عملوا الصالحات» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سندخلهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: «سندخلهم» is an imperfect verb and its first object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu"; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun; «جنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿تجري... الخ﴾ ("… etc.") is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات»; «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين»; «أبدًا» is an adverb, also attached to «خالدين»; and the clause ﴿والذين آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعد الله حقا﴾: ﴿وعد﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. The Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حقًّا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause, the implied form being "that is true, truly".
﴿ومن أصدق من الله قيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; «أصدق» is the khabar; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أصدق»; «قيلًا» is a tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿ومن أصدق...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿ليس بأمانيكم ولا أماني أهل الكتاب﴾: ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; the bāʾ is a linking (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; «أمانيكم» is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the khabar (predicate) of «ليس»; and the clause ﴿ليس بأمانيكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ولا أماني أهل الكتاب﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أمانيكم».
﴿من يعمل سوءا يجز به﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); «يعمل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «سوءًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يجز» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجز﴾; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿ولا يجد له من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا﴾: conjoined to ﴿يجز﴾ and jussive like it; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وليًّا﴾ and was then put before it; ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يجد», standing as the first object; «وليًّا» is the second object; and «نصيرًا» is conjoined to ﴿وليًّا﴾.

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿ومن يعمل من الصالحات من ذكر أو أنثى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يعمل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «من الصالحات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعمل»; «من ذكر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it removes the vagueness from ﴿من﴾; and ﴿أو أنثى﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿وهو مؤمن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هو» is mubtadaʾ and «مؤمن» khabar (predicate); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فأولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون نقيرا﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ; the clause «يدخلون الجنة» is the khabar; «لا يظلمون» is conjoined to «يدخلون»; «نقيرًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it qualifies the maṣdar; the clause ﴿أولئك يدخلون﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿ومن أحسن دينا ممن أسلم وجهه لله وهو محسن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «أحسن» is its khabar (predicate); «دينًا» is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the mubtadaʾ; «ممن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحسن»; the clause ﴿أسلم وجهه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسلم﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ and «محسن» khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿أسلم﴾.
﴿واتبع ملة إبراهيم حنيفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause «اتبع» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أسلم», falling within the scope of the ṣila; «ملة إبراهيم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «حنيفًا» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبع», or from «إبراهيم».
﴿واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the clause ﴿اتخذ الله إبراهيم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; «خليلًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «اتخذ»; and the clause ﴿واتخذ الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
