﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في السماوات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿ولله ما في السماوات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and ﴿وما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وكان الله بكل شيء محيطا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «محيطًا» its khabar; and ﴿بكل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿محيطًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿ويستفتونك في النساء قل الله يفتيكم فيهن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «يستفتونك» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «في النساء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستفتونك»; «قل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being "anta", and the clause is also resumptive, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); «يفتيكم» is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿الله يفتيكم﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and «فيهن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يفتيكم».
﴿وما يتلى عليكم في الكتاب في يتامى النساء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿وما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun latent in ﴿يفتيكم﴾, which refers back to Allah the Exalted; [or] ﴿ما﴾ is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "gives you a ruling"; «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يتلى»; «في الكتاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «في يتامى النساء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word] that is a badal (substitute) from ﴿فيهن﴾; and the annexation of ﴿يتامى﴾ to ﴿النساء﴾ is of the type: annexation of the qualifier to the qualified.
﴿اللاتي لا تؤتونهن ما كتب لهن﴾: «اللاتي» is a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «النساء»; the clause ﴿لا تؤتونهن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿كتب﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كتب».
﴿وترغبون أن تنكحوهن﴾: conjoined to «تؤتونهن». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن تنكحوهن﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, which is either ﴿في﴾, i.e. "[you desire] to marry them for their beauty and their wealth", or ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "you are averse to marrying them because of their plainness and their poverty".
﴿والمستضعفين من الولدان﴾: conjoined to «يتامى النساء»; and «من الولدان» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وأن تقوموا لليتامى بالقسط﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تقوموا﴾ is genitive by conjunction to «المستضعفين»; or accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun then being attached to an omitted [verb] conjoined to what preceded, i.e. "and He commands you to stand"; «لليتامى» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and «بالقسط» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تقوموا».
﴿وما تفعلوا من خير فإن الله كان به عليما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; «تفعلوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; «من خير» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تفعلوا»; the fāʾ is connective; the clause ﴿إن الله﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿ما﴾; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; «عليمًا» is the khabar of «كان»; and «به», the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to ﴿عليمًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is a munādā (one addressed) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); الناس is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; اتقوا ربكم is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة﴾: الذي is an adjective of ﴿ربكم﴾; the clause خلقكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿من نفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقكم﴾; واحدة is an adjective; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.
﴿وخلق منها زوجها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; خلق is a past verb; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلق﴾; زوجها is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وبث منهما رجالا كثيرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; بث is a past verb; ﴿منهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بث﴾; رجالًا is a mafʿūl bihi; كثيرًا is an adjective; and نساء is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿رجالًا﴾.
﴿واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اتقوا is an imperative verb; الذي is an adjective; the clause ﴿تساءلون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تساءلون﴾.
﴿والأرحام﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿إن الله كان عليكم﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause of كان and what is in its scope is the khabar (predicate) of إن; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رقيبًا﴾; and the noun of كان is latent (mustatir).
﴿رقيبًا﴾: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿وآتوا اليتامى أموالهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; or: conjoined (maʿṭūfa); آتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); اليتامى is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and أموالهم the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا تتبدلوا الخبيث بالطيب﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); تتبدلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; الخبيث is a mafʿūl bihi; the bāʾ is a preposition and الطيب is genitive by it, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتبدلوا﴾.
﴿ولا تأكلوا أموالهم إلى أموالكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; أموالهم is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلى أموالكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "joined to your wealth."
﴿إنه كان حوبا كبيرا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (huwa), and its khabar (predicate) is the khabar of إن; and the clause of إن and what is in its scope is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source, which appears garbled here; the intended sense is evidently that حوبًا is the khabar of كان (with كبيرًا its adjective) and that the clause of كان is the khabar of إن.]

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وإن خفتم ألا تقسطوا في اليتامى﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that makes accusative; لا is negating; تقسطوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what is in its scope is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في اليتامى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقسطوا; and the clause ﴿وإن خفتم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فانكحوا ما طاب لكم من النساء مثنى وثلاث ورباع﴾: the fāʾ links the answer; انكحوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a jussive as the protasis [Translator's note: so in the source, «في محل جزم فعل الشرط»; the sense requires "as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ)"]; ما is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause طاب has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طاب﴾; ﴿من النساء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the fāʿil; ﴿مثنى وثلاث ورباع﴾ are ḥāls, or: a badal (substitute) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿فإن خفتم ألا تعدلوا فواحدة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن لا تعدلوا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فواحدة﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and واحدة is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. "then keep to one," and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن خفتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أو ما ملكت أيمانكم﴾: أو is a conjunction, for giving a choice (takhyīr); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿واحدة﴾; and the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانكم﴾ has no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك أدنى ألا تعولوا﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿أدنى﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن لا تعولوا﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أدنى﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وآتوا النساء صدقاتهن نحلة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿آتوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); النساء is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); صدقاتهن is a second mafʿūl bihi; نحلة is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), or as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from those addressed or from ﴿صدقاتهن﴾, or: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فإن طبن لكم عن شيء منه نفسا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional; ﴿طبن﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl; ﴿عن شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طبن﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of شيء; نفسًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿فكلوه هنيئا مريئا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿كلوه﴾ is an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi; هنيئًا مريئًا are two adjectives of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "an eating wholesome and pleasant," or a ḥāl from the pronoun; and the clause ﴿فإن طبن لكم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ولا تؤتوا السفهاء أموالكم التي جعل الله لكم قياما﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تؤتوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); السفهاء is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أموالكم is a second mafʿūl bihi; التي is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أموالكم﴾; the clause ﴿جعل الله لكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; قيامًا is the second mafʿūl bihi of جعل, which is in the meaning of "made [into]" (ṣayyara), and the first object is omitted, the implied form being: "which He made for you a means of support"; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قيامًا﴾; and if جعل is in the meaning of "created," then قيامًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted returning pronoun (ʿāʾid), i.e. "He made it in the state of its being a means of support."
﴿وارزقوهم فيها واكسوهم وقولوا لهم قولا معروفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ارزقوهم is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ارزقوهم﴾; اكسوهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ارزقوهم﴾; قولوا is also conjoined to ﴿وارزقوهم﴾; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قولوا﴾; قولًا: a mafʿūl bihi, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by the fatḥa; معروفًا is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وابتلوا اليتامى حتى إذا بلغوا النكاح﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the speech is conjoined (maʿṭūf); اليتامى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb ﴿ابتلوا﴾; حتى is a particle of terminus (ghāya) and a preposition; and it was said: حتى is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), but it conveys terminus; إذا is a future adverb including the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿بلغوا النكاح﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct).
﴿فإن آنستم منهم رشدا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is conditional; آنستم is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿فإن آنستم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آنستم﴾; رشدًا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم﴾: the fāʾ is linking; ادفعوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادفعوا﴾; أموالكم is a mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source, «وأموالكم»; the ayah has ﴿أموالهم﴾]; and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ولا تأكلوها إسرافا وبدارا أن يكبروا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تأكلوها is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is the object; إسرافًا and بدارًا are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being extravagant and hastening"; or they are in the place of a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of your extravagance and your hastening [ahead of] their growing up"; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يكبروا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar ﴿بدارا﴾, or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, the mafʿūl bihi being omitted, and in that case a muḍāf must be implied, i.e. "for fear that they grow up"; and the clause ﴿ولا تأكلوها...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun (ism) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (huwa); غنيًّا is its khabar (predicate); the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿من﴾; فليستعفف: the fāʾ links the apodosis, the lām is the lām of command, and يستعفف is jussive by it. The clause ﴿ومن كان غنيا فليستعفف﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن كان فقيرا فليأكل بالمعروف﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; كان is a defective past verb, its noun latent, its implied form being "he"; فقيرا is its khabar; ﴿فليأكل﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, the lām is the lām of command, and يأكل is jussive by it; بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأكل﴾; and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿فإذا دفعتم إليهم أموالهم فأشهدوا عليهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time; the clause ﴿دفعتم إليهم أموالهم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by iḍāfa; the fāʾ links the apodosis; أشهدوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشهدوا﴾. The clause ﴿فإذا دفعتم إليهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكفى بالله حسيبا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; كفى is a past verb; ﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil of كفى, genitive in form by the bāʾ; حسيبًا is a tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿وكفى بالله حسيبا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وإذا لآتيناهم من لدنا أجرا عظيما﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative because it comes after one of the two conjunctions, namely the wāw and the fāʾ; it is an answer to an implied question, as if it were asked: "And what will they have after being made firm?", and it was said: "In that case, had they been made firm, We would have given them". The lām is [in] the apodosis of the implied ﴿لو﴾; آتيناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من لدنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آتيناهم; أجرًا is a mafʿūl bihi; and عظيمًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿ولهديناهم صراطا مستقيما﴾: Also conjoined (maʿṭūf); صراطًا is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition; and مستقيمًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿ومن يطع الله والرسول﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. مَن is conditional, in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يطع الله﴾ is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); and الرسولَ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty.
﴿فأولئك مع الذين أنعم الله عليهم من النبيين والصديقين والشهداء والصالحين﴾: The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); أولئك is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); الذين is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the clause ﴿أنعم الله عليهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; من النبيين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and what follows it is conjoined to النَّبيِّين.
﴿وحسن أولئك رفيقا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; حسن is a past verb that includes the meaning of praise and wonder; أولئك is a demonstrative, the fāʿil (agent); and رفيقًا is a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿ذلك الفضل من الله وكفى بالله عليما﴾: The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الفضل is a badal (substitute) from it; and ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); or الفضل is the khabar, and ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿ذلك الفضل من الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. كفى is a past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) particle; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) in position and genitive in form; عليمًا is a tamyīz (specification) or a ḥāl; and the clause ﴿وكفى بالله عليما﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا خذوا حذركم فانفروا ثبات أو انفروا جميعا﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; خذوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa), and the wāw is the fāʿil; حذركم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; انفروا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خذوا, i.e., "hasten against them before they hasten against you"; ثبات is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural; ﴿أو انفروا﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿انفروا﴾; and جميعًا is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وإن منكم لمن ليبطئن﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿لمن﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), whose function is emphasis, and ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as its postponed noun; ﴿ليبطئن﴾: the lām is [in] the answer to an omitted oath, the implied speech being: "and among you is he who has sworn: he will surely lag behind"; the clause of the answer to the oath has no grammatical position, and the clause of the oath with its answer is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. يبطئن may be intransitive, or it may be transitive with the object omitted, i.e., "he will surely hold others back".
﴿فإن أصابتكم مصيبة قال قد أنعم الله علي﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; أصابتكم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); مصيبة is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); and the clause ﴿قد أنعم الله علي﴾ is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿إذ لم أكن معهم شهيدا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to أنعم; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; أكن is an incomplete imperfect verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), implied as "anā" (I); معهم is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); شهيدًا is the khabar of أكن; and the clause ﴿فإن أصابتكم مصيبة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿ولئن أصابكم فضل من الله﴾: The wāw conjoins [this] to His words ﴿فإن أصابتكم مصيبة﴾; the lām is the lām that prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أصابكم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فضل is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective).
﴿ليقولن كأن لم تكن بينكم وبينه مودة﴾: The lām is [in] the answer to the oath; يقولنّ: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath, since the oath came first. كأن: lightened from the heavy [كأنّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause ﴿لم تكن...﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause of ﴿كأن﴾ with what is in its domain is parenthetical between the saying and what is said, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial from the fāʿil of يقولن. بينكم is an adverb attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿تكن﴾; بينهم [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is ﴿وبينه﴾] is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; and مودة is the postponed noun of ﴿تكن﴾.
﴿يا ليتني كنت معهم فأفوز فوزا عظيما﴾: The clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle with the one addressed omitted, or it is merely for drawing attention; ﴿ليت﴾ is an abrogating particle; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the yāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنت﴾ is the khabar of ليت; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; معهم is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿فأفوز﴾: the fāʾ is the causal (sababiyya) fāʾ, and أفوز is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e., "there is a wish for my being [with them] and then a triumph". فوزًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and عظيمًا a ṣifa.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿فليقاتل في سبيل الله الذين يشرون الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ), i.e., "if you know all this, then let [them] fight". The lām is the lām of command; يقاتل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقاتل; الذين is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يشرون الحياة الدنيا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بالآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يشرون; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ومن يقاتل في سبيل الله﴾: The wāw is resumptive; مَن is a jussive-governing conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); يقاتل is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); and ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقاتل.
﴿فيقتل أو يغلب فسوف نؤتيه أجرا عظيما﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; يقتل, built for what has not had its agent named (passive), is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يقاتل, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "huwa" (he); أو يغلب: أو is a conjunction, and يغلب, built for the agent (active), is also conjoined, and the fāʿil is latent, implied as "huwa"; فسوف: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis; نؤتيه is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is latent, the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), أجرًا the second mafʿūl bihi, and عظيمًا a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يقاتل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿وما لكم لا تقاتلون في سبيل الله﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun whose meaning is command and disapproval, in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿لا تقاتلون في سبيل الله﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿والمستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدان﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty, and a muḍāf must be supposed, i.e., "you do not fight in the cause of rescuing the oppressed". من الرجال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿الذين يقولون ربنا أخرجنا من هذه القرية الظالم أهلها﴾: الذين is a relative noun, a ṣifa (adjective); the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿ربنا﴾ is a muḍāf vocative (munādā muḍāf) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; أخرجنا is a verb of supplication, and ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); ﴿من هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرجنا; القرية is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; الظالم is a causal adjective (naʿt sababī); and أهلها is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿الظالم﴾, because it is an active participle.
﴿واجعل لنا من لدنك وليا﴾: Conjoined to ﴿أخرجنا﴾; ﴿لنا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of اجعل; من لدنك is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; and وليًّا is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واجعل لنا من لدنك نصيرا﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿الذين آمنوا يقاتلون في سبيل الله﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يقاتلون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقاتلون﴾.
﴿والذين كفروا يقاتلون في سبيل الطاغوت﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause; الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يقاتلون﴾ is its khabar; and ﴿في سبيل الطاغوت﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقاتلون.
﴿فقاتلوا أولياء الشيطان﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ); قاتلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿أولياء الشيطان﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن كيد الشيطان كان ضعيفا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); كيد is its noun; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is its khabar; ضعيفًا is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the clause of إن with what follows it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿ورسلا قد قصصناهم عليك من قبل﴾: (رسلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb conjoined to (أوحينا), its implied form being "وآتينا"; the clause (قد قصصناهم) is a naʿt (adjective); (عليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قصصنا); and (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ورسلا لم نقصصهم عليك﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وكلم الله موسى تكليما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (كلّم الله) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (موسى) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (تكليمًا) stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar).

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿رسلا مبشرين ومنذرين﴾: (رسلًا) is a badal (substitute) for (رسلًا) before it, or it is accusative (manṣūb) by way of praise; (مبشرين) is a naʿt (adjective); and (منذرين) is conjoined to (مبشرين).
﴿لئلا يكون للناس على الله حجة بعد الرسل﴾: this lām is the lām of (كي) and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) (منذرين), or to (مبشرين), or to something omitted, i.e. "We sent them for that"; (أن) is a particle that puts the verb in the accusative; (لا) is negating; (يكون) is a defective imperfect verb, accusative by (أن); (للناس) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of (يكون); (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (حجة) is the postponed noun (ism) of (يكون); and (بعد الرسل) is an adverb of time attached to the meaning of the negation, i.e. so that their argument and excuse are removed after the sending of the messengers.
﴿وكان الله عزيزا حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كان) is a defective, abrogating past verb; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); (عزيزا حكيما) are its two predicates; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:166-166.t:
﴿لكن الله يشهد بما أنزل إليك﴾: this clause of istidrāk (rectification) is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it explains an omitted clause, i.e. "They do not bear witness, but Allah bears witness." (لكن) is lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يشهد) is the khabar (predicate); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشهد); and the clause (أنزل إليك) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنزله بعلمه﴾: the clause is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, or resumptive; on both views it has no grammatical position. (أنزل) is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو". (بعلمه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by His own particular knowledge", or: ﴿حال كونه معلومًا لله تعالى﴾ ("while it is known to Allah the Exalted").
﴿والملائكة يشهدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الملائكة) is a mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause (يشهدون).
﴿وكفى بالله شهيدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كفى) is a past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position; (شهيدًا) is a tamyīz (specification); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:167-167.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; (الذين) is its noun (ism); the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause (صدوا) is conjoined to it; and ﴿عن سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صدوا﴾.
﴿قد ضلوا ضلالا بعيدا﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (ضلالًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (بعيدًا) is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿إن الذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:168-168.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا وظلموا لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it serves to explain their fate. (إن) is an abrogating particle; (الذين) is its noun (ism); the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; the clause (ظلموا) is conjoined to the ṣila, with no grammatical position; the clause (لم يكن الله) is its khabar (predicate); (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (يكن) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); the Name of Majesty is its noun; in ﴿ليغفر﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); (يغفر) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (أن) after the lām of denial; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of (يكن), i.e. "intending to forgive them".
﴿ولا ليهديهم طريقا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (ليهديهم) is conjoined to (ليغفر); and (طريقًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t:
﴿إلا طريق جهنم خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (طريق) is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil); (جهنم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with fatḥa as the sign of its genitive because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and feminine; (خالدين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of (يهديهم); and (أبدًا) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين).
﴿وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كان) is a defective, abrogating past verb; (ذلك) is its noun (ism); (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسيرًا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl; (يسيرًا) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:170-170.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس قد جاءكم الرسول بالحق من ربكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle for one at a middle distance; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الناس) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جاءكم الرسول) is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); (بالحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاءكم); and (من ربكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فآمنوا خيرا لكم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; (آمنوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; (خيرًا) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), which has been omitted together with its noun, i.e. "If the matter is as you have come to know, then believe, and belief will be better for you"; or it is a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "so believe with a belief that is better for you"; or it is accusative by an implied verb, i.e. "aim for" or "bring about what is better for you than what you are in"; and (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿وإن تكفروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تكفروا) is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then your disbelief does not harm Him", because He is free of need of you.
﴿فإن لله ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle; (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted, fronted khabar; (ما) is a relative noun, its postponed noun (ism); (في السماوات والأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وكان الله عليما حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كان) is a defective, abrogating past verb; the Name of Majesty is its noun; (عليما حكيما) are its two predicates; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:171-171.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب لا تغلوا في دينكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle; (أهل الكتاب) is a muḍāf munādā (one addressed in a genitive construct); (لا) is prohibitive; (تغلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); and (في دينكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تغلوا).
﴿ولا تقولوا على الله إلا الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقولوا) is a jussive imperfect verb; (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تقولوا); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿الحق﴾ stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except the true saying", or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنما المسيح عيسى ابن مريم رسول الله وكلمته ألقاها إلى مريم وروح منه﴾: (إنما) is the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (المسيح) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (عيسى) is a badal (substitute) for it; (ابن مريم) is likewise a badal, or a naʿt; (رسول الله) is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إنما المسيح عيسى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (كلمته) is conjoined to (رسول); the clause ﴿ألقاها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and ﴿قد﴾ must be assumed with it; what governs the ḥāl is the meaning of ﴿كلمته﴾, because the meaning of "the word" is that he was brought into being by it without a father; (إلى مريم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ألقاها); (روح) is conjoined to (كلمته); (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of (روح); and (من) marks the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya).
﴿فآمنوا بالله ورسله ولا تقولوا ثلاثة﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if the matter is so, then believe in Allah with a belief befitting Him, the Exalted"; (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (آمنوا); (رسله) is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقولوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive by it; (ثلاثة) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "and do not say: our gods are three"; and the clause ﴿آلهتنا ثلاثة﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿انتهوا خيرا لكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (انتهوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (خيرًا) is the khabar of (كان), which has been omitted together with its noun, i.e. "If the matter is as you have come to know, then desist, and desisting will be better for you"; or it is accusative by an implied verb, its implied form being "aim for" or "bring about what is better for you"; or it is a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "desist with a desisting that is better for you"; and (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿إنما الله إله واحد﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (إنما) is the restraining and restrained particle; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; (إله) is the khabar; and (واحد) is a naʿt.
﴿سبحانه أن يكون له ولد﴾: (سبحانه) stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "[far exalted] from His having a son", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (سبحان); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of (يكون); (ولد) is its postponed noun (ism); and the clause of exaltation (tanzīh) is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "being exalted above [that]".
﴿له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: (له) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ما) is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ; (في السماوات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (ما في الأرض) is conjoined to (ما في السماوات); and the clause ﴿له ما في السماوات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكفى بالله وكيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كفى) is a past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, [nominative] in position and genitive in form; (وكيلًا) is a tamyīz (specification) or a ḥāl; and the clause ﴿كفى بالله وكيلا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿وإن امرأة خافت من بعلها نشوزا أو إعراضا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إن﴾ is conditional. «امرأة»: the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, indicated by the verb mentioned after it. The clause ﴿خافت من بعلها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿من بعلها﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خافت», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نشوزًا﴾, and when it was put before it, it was parsed as a ḥāl; «نشوزًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «إعراضًا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نشوزًا﴾.
﴿فلا جناح عليهما أن يصلحا بينهما صلحا﴾: the fāʾ is connective; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation, and «جناح» is its noun; «عليها» is attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يصلحا بينهما﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in reconciliation", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «جناح», or to an omitted naʿt of it; ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿صلحًا﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar).
[Translator's note: the source writes «عليها» here, whereas the ayah reads «عليهما».]
﴿والصلح خير﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and the clause of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأحضرت الأنفس الشح﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أحضرت»: a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive); «الأنفس»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «الشحّ»: the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is conjoined to the preceding parenthetical clause, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن تحسنوا وتتقوا فإن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is conditional; «تحسنوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and «تتقوا» is conjoined to it; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, being known, i.e. "then doing good and being mindful [of Allah] is better"; the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is its khabar; «بما تعملون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبيرًا﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause); and «خبيرًا» is the khabar of «كان».

muyesser-irab:129-129.t:
﴿ولن تستطيعوا أن تعدلوا بين النساء﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future; «تستطيعوا» is an imperfect, subjunctive (manṣūb) by «لن», the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن تعدلوا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تستطيعوا»; and ﴿بين النساء﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعدلوا».
﴿ولو حرصتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; and «حرصتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿فلا تميلوا كل الميل فتذروها كالمعلقة﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know that, then do not incline", and the clause has no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تميلوا» is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; ﴿كل الميل﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿فتذروها﴾: the fāʾ is the causal (sababiyya) one, and «تذروها» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied «أن» after the causal fāʾ, because it occurs in reply to a prohibition; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no inclining on your part, and so a leaving". Or the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «تذروها» is conjoined to «تميلوا»; ﴿كالمعلقة﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of ﴿تذروها﴾; and ﴿المعلقة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإن تصلحوا وتتقوا فإن الله كان غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «تصلحوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and «تتقوا» is conjoined to it; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, being known, i.e. "then reconciliation and being mindful [of Allah] is better"; the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty is its noun; and the clause of «كان» and its two khabars (predicates) is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:130-130.t:
﴿وإن يتفرقا يغن الله كلا من سعته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «يتفرقا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil (agent); «يغن» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; «كلًّا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «من سعته» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغن﴾.
﴿وكان الله واسعا حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and ﴿واسعا حكيما﴾ are its two khabars (predicates); and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:131-131.t:
﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿ولله ما في السماوات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿ولقد وصينا الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم وإياكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the lām of an implied oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «وصينا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «الذين» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أوتوا الكتاب﴾ is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position; «الكتاب» is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أوتوا﴾; the clause ﴿قد وصينا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the implied oath; «من قبلكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿وإياكم﴾ is conjoined to «الذين», i.e. "and We enjoined you".
﴿أن اتقوا الله﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "to be mindful", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿وصينا﴾. The clause ﴿اتقوا الله﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ولقد وصينا الذين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن تكفروا فإن لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is a jussive conditional particle; «تكفروا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then you will not harm Him in anything"; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿إن﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the postponed noun of ﴿إنّ﴾; «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and «ما في الأرض» is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وكان الله غنيا حميدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «غنيا حميدا» are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t:
﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and «ما في الأرض» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وكفى بالله وكيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كفى» is a past verb; the bāʾ is a linking (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); «وكيلًا» is a tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿وكفى بالله وكيلا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t:
﴿إن يشأ يذهبكم أيها الناس ويأت بآخرين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «يشأ» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «يذهبكم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿أيها الناس﴾: «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative, ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and «الناس» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «يأت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يذهبكم»; and «بآخرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأت﴾.
﴿وكان الله على ذلك قديرا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «قديرًا» its khabar (predicate); ﴿على ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قديرًا﴾; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿من كان يريد ثواب الدنيا﴾: ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «كان» is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its noun latent (mustatir), referring back to ﴿مَن﴾; the clause «يريد» is its khabar (predicate); and «ثواب الدنيا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فعند الله ثواب الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿عند﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «ثواب الدنيا» is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وكان الله سميعا بصيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «سميعا بصيرا» are its two khabars; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿كونوا قوامين بالقسط﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «كونوا» is a defective imperative verb (of kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and «قوامين» its khabar (predicate); and «بالقسط» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قوامين».
﴿شهداء لله ولو على أنفسكم﴾: «شهداء» is a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شهداء»; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; «على أنفسكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «كان», which is omitted together with its noun after the conditional ﴿لو﴾, i.e. "even if the testimony is against yourselves"; and the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, i.e. "then do not hold back from giving testimony".
﴿أو الوالدين والأقربين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «أنفسكم».
﴿إن يكن غنيا أو فقيرا فالله أولى بهما﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «يكن» is a defective imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the noun of «يكن» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "the one testified against"; «غنيًّا» is the khabar of «يكن»; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and «فقيرًا» is conjoined to ﴿غنيًّا﴾; ﴿فالله﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أولى» is the khabar; ﴿بهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أولى»; and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿فلا تتبعوا الهوى أن تعدلوا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تتبعوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil; «الهوى» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), from ﴿تعدلوا﴾ either in the sense of justice (ʿadl), the implied form then being "out of dislike that you act justly", or in the sense of deviating (ʿudūl), the implied form then being "desiring that you deviate".
﴿وإن تلووا أو تعرضوا فإن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿تلووا﴾ is the protasis, and ﴿أو تعرضوا﴾ is conjoined to it; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the connective fāʾ, the implied form being "He will punish you"; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty is its noun; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun latent, and «خبيرًا» its khabar; the clause of «كان» is its [i.e. inna's] khabar; ﴿بما تعملون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبيرًا﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila; and the whole clause gives the reason for what preceded, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:136-136.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿آمنوا بالله ورسوله والكتاب الذي نزل على رسوله﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «آمنوا» is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنوا﴾; ﴿ورسوله﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty; «الكتاب» is also conjoined; «الذي» is a naʿt of «الكتاب»; and the clause ﴿نزل على رسوله﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.
﴿والكتاب الذي أنزل من قبل﴾: ﴿والكتاب﴾ is also conjoined, i.e. the genus of scripture, the intended meaning being the revealed books; «الذي» is a naʿt; the clause ﴿أنزل﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a preposition, and ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أنزل﴾.
﴿ومن يكفر بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يكفر» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يكفر»; and what follows it is conjoined to it.
﴿فقد ضل ضلالا بعيدا﴾: «فقد»: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «ضل» is a past verb; «ضلالًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and «بعيدًا» a naʿt; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يكفر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿للرجال نصيب مما ترك الوالدان والأقربون﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; للرجال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); نصيب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of نصيب; the clause ﴿ترك الوالدان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; الأقربون is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الوالدان﴾.
﴿وللنساء نصيب مما ترك الوالدان والأقربون﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿مما قل منه أو كثر نصيبا مفروضا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of the preceding ﴿مما﴾; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قل﴾; ﴿أو كثر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قل﴾; نصيبًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿قل﴾, or accusative (manṣūb) by an implied verb, i.e. "I made obligatory, or I appointed, for them a share." مفروضًا: an accusative naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وإذا حضر القسمة أولو القربى واليتامى والمساكين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is a future adverb including the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿حضر القسمة﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct); القسمة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أولوا القربى﴾ is a nominative (marfūʿ) fāʿil (agent), the sign of its being nominative being the wāw, because it is attached to [the class of] the sound masculine plural; اليتامى and المساكين are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أولوا القربى﴾.
﴿فارزقوهم منه وق ولوا لهم قولا معروفا﴾: [Translator's note: the heading reads «وق ولوا» in the source, a typographical split of ﴿وقولوا﴾.] The fāʾ links the answer of ﴿إذا﴾; ارزقوهم is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قولوا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; by position, منه would be attached to ﴿ارزقوهم﴾]; قولوا is conjoined to ﴿ارزقوهم﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قولوا﴾; قولًا: a mafʿūl bihi, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by the fatḥa; معروفًا is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿وإذا حضر القسمة...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وليخش الذين لو تركوا من خلفهم ذرية ضعافا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يخش is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām; الذين is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); لو is conditional; تركوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿من خلفهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركوا﴾; ذرية is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ضعافًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿خافوا عليهم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خافوا﴾; and the object of خافوا is omitted and implied.
﴿فليتقوا الله﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); the lām is the lām of command; يتقوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām; the wāw is the fāʿil; and the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وليقولوا قولا سديدا﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to ﴿فليتقوا﴾; قولًا: a mafʿūl bihi, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by the fatḥa; سديدًا is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إن الذين يأكلون أموال اليتامى ظلما﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; الذين is its noun (ism); the clause يأكلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أموال اليتامى is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ظلمًا﴾ is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being wrongdoers"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), to show the kind of eating, i.e. "an eating of wrongdoing."
﴿إنما يأكلون في بطونهم نارا وسيصلون سعيرا﴾: إنما is a restraining [ما] and a restrained [إن] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), without governing effect; يأكلون is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the first إن; ﴿في بطونهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأكلون﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl; نارًا is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وسيصلون﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يأكلون﴾; سعيرًا is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يوصيكم الله في أولادكم﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; يوصيكم is an imperfect verb, the kāf is its fronted object, and the Name of Majesty is its postponed fāʿil (agent); في أولادكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوصيكم.
﴿للذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; للذكر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مثل is an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "a share like ..."; so the clause is as it were an explanation of the first, and thus it is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as what is enjoined [the object] of يوصيكم.
﴿فإن كن نساء فوق اثنتين فلهن ثلثا ما ترك﴾: the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿ), and the clause after it has no grammatical position, because it is equivalent to a resumptive and causal [clause]; إن is conditional; ﴿كن﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is its noun (ism); ﴿نساء﴾ is its khabar; ﴿فوق﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of نساء; فوق is muḍāf and ﴿اثنتين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ; ﴿فلهن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ثلثا is a postponed mubtadaʾ, the sign of its being nominative being the alif because it is dual; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa; the clause ﴿ترك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿فلهن ثلثا﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وإن كانت واحدة فلها النصف﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is conditional; كانت is a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "she" (hiya), i.e. the female offspring; واحدة is the khabar of كانت; the fāʾ links the answer; لها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; النصف is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ولأبويه لكل واحد منهما السدس مما ترك إن كان له ولد﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لأبويه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿لكل واحد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun [Translator's note: the source does not state what it is attached to]; منهما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of واحد; السدس is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿ترك﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; ﴿كان له ولد﴾: كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; ولد is its postponed noun; the apodosis is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e. "then each one ..."; and the conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن لم يكن له ولد وورثه أبواه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and making jussive; يكن is a defective imperfect verb, jussive; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ولد is its postponed noun; ورثه is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لم يكن; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أبواه is the fāʿil.
﴿فلأمه الثلث﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لأمه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الثلث is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the clause ﴿فإن لم يكن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن كان له إخوة فلأمه السدس﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿من بعد وصية يوصي بها أو دين﴾: ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the division of these shares is after a bequest"; and it was said: attached to His saying ﴿يوصيكم الله﴾ and what follows it; and it was said: attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "they are entitled to that after a bequest"; and it was said: attached to an omitted ḥāl from السدس, its implied form being "being due after a bequest." The clause يوصي is an adjective of وصية; أو is a conjunction; دين is conjoined to وصية.
﴿آباؤكم وأبناؤكم لا تدرون أيهم أقرب لكم نفعا﴾: the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position. آباؤكم: mubtadaʾ; أبناؤكم: conjoined to ﴿آباؤكم﴾. The clause ﴿لا تدرون﴾: khabar; أيهم: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; أقرب: its khabar; and the clause is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of تدرون, because it [the verb] is suspended (ʿulliqa) by the interrogative; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقرب; نفعًا is a tamyīz (specification). Or: أي is relative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and it is the object of تدرون, and أقرب is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they are nearer"; as for the second object of تدرون, it is omitted.
﴿فريضة﴾: فريضة is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), a maṣdar (verbal noun) emphasising the content of the preceding clause, i.e. "He ordained that as an ordinance."
﴿من الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of فريضة.
﴿إن الله كان عليما حكيما﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿كان عليمًا حكيمًا﴾ is its khabar; and the clause of إن and what is in its scope is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ولكم نصف ما ترك أزواجكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); نصف is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿ترك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; أزواجكم is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن لم يكن لهن ولد﴾: إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and making jussive; يكن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and it is also the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لهن﴾ is the fronted khabar of يكن, and ولد its postponed noun (ism); the conditional clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.
﴿فإن كان لهن ولد﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; إن is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; ولد is its postponed noun; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).
﴿فلكم الربع مما تركن﴾: the fāʾ is linking; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الربع is a postponed mubtadaʾ; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿تركن﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause joined with the fāʾ is the apodosis.
﴿من بعد وصية يوصين بها أو دين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; وصية is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause يوصين is an adjective (ṣifa) of وصية; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوصين; أو is a conjunction; دين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to وصية.
﴿ولهن الربع مما تركتم إن لم يكن لكم ولد﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الربع is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from الربع; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿لكم نصف﴾, with no grammatical position; تركتم is a past verb, and the pronoun is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as fāʿil; the clause ﴿تركتم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion and making jussive; يكن is an imperfect verb, jussive by لم, and it is also the protasis; ﴿لكم﴾ is the fronted khabar of يكن, and ولد its postponed noun; the conditional clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; and the apodosis is omitted, what precedes indicating it.
﴿فإن كان لكم ولد﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; إن is conditional; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; ولد is its postponed noun; and the clause is conjoined.
﴿فلهن الثمن مما تركتم﴾: the fāʾ is linking; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الثمن is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿تركتم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause joined with the fāʾ is the apodosis.
﴿من بعد وصية توصون بها أو دين﴾: ﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; وصية is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿توصون﴾ is an adjective of وصية; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توصون﴾; أو is a conjunction; دين is conjoined to وصية.
﴿وإن كان رجل يورث كلالة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective particle [Translator's note: so in the source, «حرف ناقص»; كان is a defective verb]; ﴿رجل﴾ is the noun of كان; ﴿ويورث﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (huwa); the clause ﴿يورث﴾ is the khabar of كان. Or: ﴿كان﴾ is a complete (tāmm) verb and ﴿رجل﴾ its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿يورث﴾ is an adjective of ﴿رجل﴾. ﴿كلالة﴾ is a ḥāl from the nāʾib fāʿil, which is the latent pronoun in ﴿يورث﴾.
﴿أو امرأة وله أخ أو أخت﴾: أو is a conjunction; امرأة is conjoined to رجل; وله: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; أخ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; أو is a conjunction; أخت is conjoined to أخ.
﴿فلكل واحد منهما السدس﴾: the fāʾ is linking; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; واحد is muḍāf ilayhi; منهما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of واحد; السدس is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿فإن كانوا أكثر من ذلك فهم شركاء في الثلث﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional; كانوا is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the wāw is the noun of كان, and أكثر its khabar; من ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أكثر; the fāʾ is linking; هم is the mubtadaʾ, and شركاء the khabar; في الثلث is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شركاء; and the clause ﴿فإن كانوا أكثر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من بعد وصية يوصى بها أو دين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; وصية is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يوصى﴾ is an adjective of وصية; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوصى﴾; أو is a conjunction; دين is conjoined to وصية.
﴿غير مضار وصية من الله﴾: ﴿غير مضار﴾ is a ḥāl from the pronoun of يوصى; وصية is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of وصية.
﴿والله عليم حليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; عليم حليم are its two khabars; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿تلك حدود الله﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and حدود الله the khabar (predicate).
﴿ومن يطع الله ورسوله يدخله جنات﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a jussive-making conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; يطع is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); يدخله is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جنات is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), or a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause of the condition and the answer is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar; and the clause ﴿ومن يطع الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها﴾: the clause تجري is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنات; من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري; الأنهار is the fāʿil (agent); خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدين.
﴿وذلك الفوز العظيم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; ذلك is the mubtadaʾ; الفوز is the khabar; العظيم is an adjective; and the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين قيل لهم كفوا أيديكم وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation expressing wonder; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause ﴿كفوا﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); أيديكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ﴿كفوا﴾.
﴿فلما كتب عليهم القتال﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿لما﴾ is a particle of existence because of existence (i.e., "when"), or an adverb meaning "at the time when", containing the meaning of condition; and the clause ﴿كتب عليهم القتال﴾ has no grammatical position because it comes after a particle-relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī), or it is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿إذا فريق منهم يخشون الناس كخشية الله﴾: إذا is the إذا of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is a particle; فريق is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخشون الناس﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of فريق; الناس is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كخشية﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e., "they fear the people with a fear like the fear of Allah"; خشية: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a maṣdar annexed to its object, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿فريق منهم... الخ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause of surprise has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿أو أشد خشية﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿أشد﴾ is conjoined to the ﴿الكاف﴾ in ﴿كخشية الله﴾, accusative; and ﴿خشية﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿وقالوا ربنا لم كتبت علينا القتال﴾: The wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction; ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined to the clause ﴿يخشون﴾; ربنا is a muḍāf vocative (munādā muḍāf) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿لم﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun whose alif has been dropped because it comes after a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كتبت; القتال is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
﴿لولا أخرتنا إلى أجل قريب﴾: ﴿لولا﴾ is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), like هلّا; أخرتنا is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is included in what they said.
﴿قل متاع الدنيا قليل﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), implied as "anta" (you); متاع الدنيا is the mubtadaʾ and قليل the khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl; and the clause ﴿قل متاع...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والآخرة خير لمن اتقى﴾: The wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial; الآخرة is the mubtadaʾ and خير the khabar, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial; ﴿لمن اتقى﴾: the lām is a preposition, مَن is a relative noun, genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خير; اتقى is a past verb, its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿والآخرة خير لمن اتقى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ولا تظلمون فتيلا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; تظلمون is an imperfect verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فتيلًا: a maṣdar substituting for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a description of the maṣdar, the implied form being: "a wrong the size of a date-stone thread".

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿أينما تكونوا يدرككم الموت﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿أينما﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكونوا﴾ if it is incomplete (nāqiṣa), or to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) if it is complete (tāmma); ﴿تكونوا﴾ is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), or the noun of تكونوا; and ﴿يدرككم الموت﴾ is the apodosis.
﴿ولو كنتم في بروج مشيدة﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; كنتم is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; في بروج is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; مشيدة is a ṣifa (adjective) of بروج; and the apodosis clause is omitted, what precedes it indicating it.
