﴿وإن تصبهم حسنة يقولوا هذه من عند الله﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; تصبهم is the protasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حسنة is the fāʿil; يقولوا is the apodosis; هذه is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من عند الله﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to an omitted khabar; and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying). The clause ﴿وإن تصبهم حسنة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن تصبهم سيئة يقولوا هذه من عندك﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿قل كل من عند الله﴾: قل is an imperative verb; كل is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿من عند الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فما لهؤلاء القوم لا يكادون يفقهون حديثا﴾: The fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ; لهؤلاء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; القوم is a badal (substitute); the clause ﴿لا يكادون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is the noun of ﴿يكاد﴾; the clause ﴿يفقهون﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of ﴿يكاد﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; حديثًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿فما لهؤلاء القوم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿ما أصابك من حسنة فمن الله﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); أصابك is a past verb in the position of jussive as the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); من حسنة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); ﴿من الله﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e., "then it is from Allah"; and the clause of the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وما أصابك من سيئة فمن نفسك﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿وأرسلناك للناس رسولا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿أرسلناك﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلناك, or to an omitted ḥāl; and رسولًا is a ḥāl.
﴿وكفى بالله شهيدا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) preposition; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil of ﴿كفى﴾, genitive by the bāʾ in form and nominative in position; and شهيدًا is a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿من يطع الرسول فقد أطاع الله﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يطع الرسول﴾ is the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); the clause ﴿فقد أطاع الله﴾ is in the position of jussive as the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of مَن.
﴿ومن تولى فما أرسلناك عليهم حفيظا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ; تولى is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; أرسلناك is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حفيظًا﴾; حفيظًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the apodosis is omitted, implied as "then do not concern yourself with him"; the protasis with its omitted apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ما أرسلناك﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿ويقولون طاعة﴾: The wāw is resumptive; يقولون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); طاعة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), implied as "our affair and our state"; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); and the clause ﴿ويقولون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا برزوا من عندك﴾: The fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿برزوا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and ﴿من عندك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) برزوا.
﴿بيت طائفة منهم غير الذي تقول﴾: The clause ﴿بيت طائفة﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of طائفة; غير is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿تقول﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله يكتب ما يبيتون﴾: The wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يكتب﴾ is the khabar; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يبيتون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and the clause ﴿والله يكتب ما يبيتون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأعرض عنهم وتوكل على الله﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ); أعرض is an imperative verb; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعرض; توكل is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أعرض; and ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكل.
﴿وكفى بالله وكيلا﴾: The wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive with the clause after it resumptive, with no grammatical position; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e., redundant) preposition; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil of ﴿كفى﴾ in position, and genitive by the bāʾ in form; and وكيلا is a tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿أفلا يتدبرون القرآن﴾: The hamza is for interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e., "do they turn away from the Quran and so not reflect on it?"; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; ﴿يتدبرون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); and القرآن is its object.
﴿ولو كان من عند غير الله لوجدوا فيه اختلافا كثيرا﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; كان is the incomplete [kāna], and its noun is latent (mustatir), i.e., the Quran; ﴿من عند غير الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; وجدوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وجدوا﴾; اختلافًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and كثيرًا is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وإذا جاءهم أمر من الأمن أو الخوف أذاعوا به﴾: Resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿جاءهم أمر﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); من الأمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أمر; الخوف is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الأمن; and the clause ﴿أذاعوا به﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ولو ردوه إلى الرسول وإلى أولي الأمر منهم﴾: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ردّوه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلى الرسول is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ردّوه; ﴿وإلى أولي الأمر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إلى الرسول﴾; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لعلمه الذين يستنبطونه منهم﴾: The lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; علمه الذين is a verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil; the clause ﴿يستنبطونه﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause ﴿لعلمه الذين﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته لاتبعتم الشيطان إلا قليلا﴾: The wāw is resumptive; ﴿لولا﴾ is a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence, containing the meaning of condition; ﴿فضل الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل; رحمته is conjoined to فضل; the lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لولا﴾; the clause ﴿اتبعتم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; الشيطان is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; قليلًا is excepted from the fāʿil of اتبعتم, i.e., "except a few of you", or from the fāʿil of ﴿أذاعوا به﴾; and the clause ﴿ولولا فضل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿فقاتل في سبيل الله لا تكلف إلا نفسك﴾: The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ), or for resumption confirming what is لما قلبه [Translator's note: so in the source; most likely a misprint for «لما قبله», "what precedes it"], and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قاتل is an imperative verb; ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قاتل; the clause ﴿لا تكلف إلا نفسك﴾, built for what has not had its agent named (passive), is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e., "while you are responsible for yourself alone, for Allah is your Helper and Supporter", and نفسك is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تكلف; or it is a resumptive clause, with no grammatical position, informing him ﷺ that He does not charge him with [anyone] other than himself.
﴿وحرض المؤمنين﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قاتل, and المؤمنين is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عسى الله أن يكف بأس الذين كفروا﴾: The clause of hope is circumstantial; عسى is a past verb, one of the verbs of hope; the Name of Majesty is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أنْ﴾ and what is in its domain is its khabar (predicate); بأس is the mafʿūl bihi; الذين كفروا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿والله أشد بأسا وأشد تنكيلا﴾: The wāw is circumstantial, or resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أشد is the khabar; بأسًا is a tamyīz (specification); أشد تنكيلًا is conjoined to what preceded; and the clause ﴿والله أشد بأسا﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿من يشفع شفاعة حسنة يكن له نصيب منها﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يشفع﴾ is an imperfect verb, the fiʿl al-sharṭ (protasis); شفاعة is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and حسنة a ṣifa (adjective); ﴿يكن﴾ is the jawāb al-sharṭ (apodosis); له is the fronted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete ﴿يكن﴾, and نصيب is its postponed noun; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa of نصيب; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of مَن.
﴿ومن يشفع شفاعة سيئة يكن له كفل منها﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿وكان الله على كل شيء مقيتا﴾: The wāw is resumptive, or circumstantial; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مقيتًا﴾; مقيتًا is the khabar of كان; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:172-172.t:
﴿لن يستنكف المسيح أن يكون عبدا لله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future reference; (يستنكف) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by it; (المسيح) is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, the implied form being "عن كونه.." ("from his being.."), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستنكف﴾; (عبدًا) is the khabar (predicate) of (يكون); and (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبدًا﴾.
﴿ولا الملائكة المقربون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (الملائكة) is conjoined to (المسيح), or it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "nor do the angels disdain"; and (المقربون) is a naʿt of (الملائكة).
﴿ومن يستنكف عن عبادته ويستكبر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (من) is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, and it is a mubtadaʾ; (يستنكف) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and (عن عبادته) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يستنكف).
﴿فسيحشرهم إليه جميعا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the implied sense being: "Whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant, He will punish him when He gathers him to Himself, and whoever does not disdain and is not arrogant, He will reward him"; or the fāʾ is a conjunction joining [this] to the omitted apodosis, its implied form being "فيجازيه" ("He will requite him"). The hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يحشرهم); (جميعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يستنكف...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:173-173.t:
﴿فأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فيوفيهم أجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله﴾: the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿ), and the clause after it has no grammatical position because it is in the nature of a resumption. (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (الذين) is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ has no grammatical position because it is conjoined to the ṣila; the fāʾ is linking; (يوفيهم) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the hāʾ is its first object, and (أجورهم) is its second object; (يزيدهم) is conjoined to ﴿فيوفيهم﴾; (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يزيدهم); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (الذين).
﴿وأما الذين استنكفوا واستكبروا فيعذبهم عذابا أليما﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (الذين) is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ; the clause (استنكفوا) is the ṣila of (الذين), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is conjoined to the ṣila; the fāʾ is linking; (يعذبهم) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو"; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عذابًا) stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and (أليمًا) is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿ولا يجدون لهم من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا﴾: conjoined to what precedes. (لهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وليًّا﴾; (من دون الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (وليًّا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (لا نصيرًا) is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:174-174.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس قد جاءكم برهان من ربكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا) is a vocative particle for one at a middle distance; (أي) is the one addressed (munādā), a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of accusative; (ها) is for alerting (tanbīh); (الناس) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جاءكم برهان) is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); and (من ربكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of (برهان).
﴿وأنزلنا إليكم نورا مبينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أنزلنا); (نورًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (مبينًا) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:175-175.t:
﴿فأما الذين آمنوا بالله واعتصموا به﴾: the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿ), and the clause has no grammatical position; (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (الذين) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا); and (اعتصموا به) is conjoined to (آمنوا).
﴿فسيدخلهم في رحمة منه وفضل﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of ﴿أما﴾; the clause (يدخلهم) is the khabar (predicate) of (الذين); (في رحمة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (يدخلهم); (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (رحمة); and (فضل) is conjoined to (رحمة).
﴿ويهديهم إليه صراطا مستقيما﴾: conjoined to (يدخلهم). (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿صراطًا﴾, placed before it; (صراطًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (يهديهم), or a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb indicated by ﴿يهديهم﴾; and (مستقيمًا) is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:176-176.t:
﴿يستفتونك قل الله يفتيكم في الكلالة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يستفتونك) is a nominative imperfect verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت"; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); (يفتيكم) is an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "هو"; the clause is the khabar (predicate); the clause (الله يفتيكم) is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and (في الكلالة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستفتونك﴾ on the view that the first [verb] governs, or to (يفتيكم) on the view that the second governs.
﴿إن امرؤ هلك ليس له ولد وله أخت﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, serving to detail the ruling. (إن) is conditional; (امرؤ) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it; the clause ﴿هلك﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position; (ليس) is a defective past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ولد) is its postponed noun (ism); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿امرؤ﴾; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (أخت) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, because it comes after the wāw of ḥāl.
﴿فلها نصف ما ترك﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (نصف) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; (ما) is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (ترك) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وهو يرثها إن لم يكن لها ولد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (هو) is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause (يرثها) is its khabar; (إن) is conditional; (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive; (يكن) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of (يكن); (ولد) is its postponed noun; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then he inherits from her".
﴿فإن كانتا اثنتين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (إن) is conditional; (كانتا) is a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; the alif in ﴿كانتا﴾ is its noun; and (اثنتين) is its khabar.
﴿فلهما الثلثان مما ترك﴾: the fāʾ is linking; ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (الثلثان) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; (مما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause (ترك) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; the fāʿil of (ترك) is latent (mustatir), referring back to the brother; and the clause ﴿فإن كانتا اثنتين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن كانوا إخوة رجالا ونساء فللذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (كانوا) is the protasis; the wāw is its noun; (إخوة) is its khabar; (رجالًا) is a badal (substitute) for ﴿إخوة﴾; (نساء) is conjoined to ﴿رجالًا﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis; (للذكر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (مثل حظ الأنثيين) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿يبين الله لكم أن تضلوا﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or it is a resumptive clause of explanation (bayāniyya) with no grammatical position. (يبين الله) is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; (لكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبين﴾; (أن تضلوا) is an interpreted maṣdar in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "out of aversion to your going astray"; and the object of (يبين) is omitted, and it is general.
﴿والله بكل شيء عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; (بكل شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to His word ﴿عليم﴾; and (عليم) is the khabar of the Name of Majesty.

muyesser-irab:137-137.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا ثم كفروا ثم آمنوا ثم كفروا ثم ازدادوا كفرا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; and «كفرًا» is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم ولا ليهديهم سبيلا﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ»; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, inversion [to past meaning] and jussive; «يكن» is a defective imperfect verb, and «الله» is its noun; ﴿ليغفر﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and «يغفر» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾ implied after it; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām of denial, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of ﴿يكن﴾, i.e. "intending forgiveness for them"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يغفر»; ﴿ولا ليهديهم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; and «سبيلًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يهديهم﴾, or accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿يهديهم﴾. The clause ﴿إن الذين آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:138-138.t: ﴿بشر المنافقين بأن لهم عذابا أليما﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «بشر المنافقين» is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the bāʾ is a preposition; «أن» and what falls within its scope are in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بشّر﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾; «عذابًا» is its postponed noun; and «أليمًا» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿الذين يتخذون الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين﴾: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المنافقين», or accusative for blame (ʿalā al-dhamm); the clause ﴿يتخذون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «الكافرين» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «أولياء» the second; and ﴿من دون المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿يتخذون﴾, or a naʿt of «أولياء».
﴿أيبتغون عندهم العزة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī); «يبتغون» is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿عندهم﴾ is an adverb attached to «يبتغون»; «العزة» is mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a clause in the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "imagining that they have might".
﴿فإن العزة لله جميعا﴾: the fāʾ is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and «العزة» is its noun; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); «جميعًا» is a ḥāl; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t:
﴿وقد نزل عليكم في الكتاب أن إذا سمعتم آيات الله يكفر بها ويستهزأ بها﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «نزل» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نزل»; «في الكتاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to «نزل», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أن﴾ is the one lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the object of ﴿نزل﴾; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿سمعتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿آيات الله﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause of ﴿إذا﴾ with its condition and its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾; the clause ﴿يكفر بها﴾ is a ḥāl, and the clause ﴿يستهزأ بها﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; and ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun standing in place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in both verbs.
﴿فلا تقعدوا معهم حتى يخوضوا في حديث غيره﴾: the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿إذا﴾; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تقعدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; ﴿معهم﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and a preposition; «يخوضوا» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾ implied after ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «تقعدوا»; «في حديث» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخوضوا»; «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حديث»; and the clause ﴿وقد نزل عليكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنكم إذًا مثلهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of answer and requital, left without effect (muhmal) because it is placed in the middle; and «مثلهم» is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.
﴿إن الله جامع المنافقين والكافرين في جهنم جميعا﴾: the clause is a second reason for the likeness; «إن» is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «جامع» its khabar; ﴿في جهنم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جامع﴾; and «جميعًا» is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:141-141.t:
﴿الذين يتربصون بكم﴾: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of «المنافقين», or accusative for blame (ʿalā al-dhamm); and the clause ﴿يتربصون بكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن كان لكم فتح من الله قالوا ألم نكن معكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «كان» is a defective past verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «فتح» is its postponed noun; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of «فتح»; «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿ألم نكن معكم﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿معكم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿نكن﴾; and the clause ﴿فإن كان لكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن كان للكافرين نصيب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «كان» is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; «للكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and «نصيب» is its postponed noun.
﴿قالوا ألم نستحوذ عليكم﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil, in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the clause ﴿ألم نستحوذ عليكم﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying.
﴿ونمنعكم من المؤمنين﴾: ﴿نمنعكم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿نستحوذ﴾; and «من المؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نمنعكم».
﴿فالله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يحكم﴾ is the khabar; ﴿بينكم﴾ is an adverb attached to «يحكم»; «يوم القيامة» is an adverb attached to «يحكم»; and the clause ﴿فالله يحكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
[Translator's note: the source prints «بيحكمن» (a slip for «بيحكم،»).]
﴿ولن يجعل الله للكافرين على المؤمنين سبيلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future; «يجعل» is an imperfect, subjunctive (manṣūb) by «لن»; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; «للكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجعل﴾, standing as its first object; «سبيلًا» is its second object; and «على المؤمنين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt of ﴿سبيلًا﴾ and was put before it.

muyesser-irab:142-142.t:
﴿إن المنافقين يخادعون الله وهو خادعهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), «المنافقين» is its noun, and the clause ﴿يخادعون الله﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إن المنافقين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl); ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «خادعهم» khabar; and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿قاموا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿إلى الصلاة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قاموا»; the second clause ﴿قاموا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and «كسالى» is a ḥāl.
﴿يراءون الناس ولا يذكرون الله إلا قليلا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl; «الناس» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لا يذكرون الله﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يراءون الناس﴾; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and «قليلًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it qualifies the maṣdar, i.e. "a little remembrance", or an adverb, i.e. "a little time".

muyesser-irab:143-143.t:
﴿مذبذبين بين ذلك﴾: «مذبذبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «بين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مذبذبين»; and «ذلك» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لا إلى هؤلاء ولا إلى هؤلاء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "belonging neither to these nor to those".
﴿ومن يضلل الله فلن تجد له سبيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يضلل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is connective; the clause ﴿لن تجد له سبيلًا﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:144-144.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتخذوا الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; «تتخذوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; «الكافرين» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «أولياء» the second; and ﴿من دون المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of «أولياء». The clause ﴿لا تتخذوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أتريدون أن تجعلوا لله عليكم سلطانا مبينا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī); «تريدون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; ﴿تجعلوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by «أن», and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the object of ﴿تريدون﴾; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجعلوا﴾, standing as the first object; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «سلطانًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «تجعلوا»; and «مبينًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿إن المنافقين في الدرك الأسفل من النار﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and «المنافقين» is its noun; ﴿في الدرك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; «الأسفل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الدرك»; and ﴿من النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولن تجد لهم نصيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future; «تجد» is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by «لن»; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نصيرًا﴾; and «نصيرًا» is the object of «تجد».

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿إلا الذين تابوا﴾: ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; «الذين» is the excepted (mustathnā); the exception clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ﴿تابوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿وأصلحوا واعتصموا بالله وأخلصوا دينهم لله﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تابوا﴾; «دينهم» is the object of «أخلصوا»; and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخلصوا».
﴿فأولئك مع المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; and «المؤمنين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. The clause ﴿فأولئك مع المؤمنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وسوف يؤت الله المؤمنين أجرا عظيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «سوف» is a particle of futurity; «يؤتي الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «المؤمنين» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «أجرًا» the second; «عظيمًا» is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿وسوف يؤت الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
[Translator's note: the source writes the verb as «يؤتي» (with yāʾ) in its parsing, while the ayah is quoted as «يؤت» (the yāʾ dropped in the script).]

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿ما يفعل الله بعذابكم﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يفعل»; «يفعل الله» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفعل»; the interrogative here means negation; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن شكرتم وآمنتم﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; «شكرتم» is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then you have avoided the punishment"; the clause ﴿إن شكرتم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and «آمنتم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «شكرتم».
﴿وكان الله شاكرا عليما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «شاكرا عليما» are its two khabars (predicates); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿لا يحب الله الجهر بالسوء من القول﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «لا» is negative; «يحب الله الجهر» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بالسوء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الجهر»; and «من القول» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «السوء».
﴿إلا من ظلم﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception; «من» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), or connected on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "except the speaking aloud of one who has been wronged"; or it is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a badal (substitute) from the agent of the maṣdar (verbal noun), which is «الجهر», the meaning being: "He does not love that anyone should speak evil aloud, except one who has been wronged, so he speaks aloud"; and «ظلم» is [read] built for what has not had its agent named (passive).
﴿وكان الله سميعا عليما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, «سميعًا» its first khabar (predicate) and «عليمًا» its second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿إن تبدوا خيرا أو تخفوه أو تعفوا عن سوء﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is conditional; «تبدوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «خيرًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أو» is a conjunction; «تعفوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «تبدوا»; and «عن سوء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعفوا».
﴿فإن الله كان عفوا قديرا﴾: the fāʾ is connective; «إن» and its noun; the clause ﴿كان عفوا قديرا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and it is the reason for the omitted apodosis, i.e. "then pardoning is better and more fitting".

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿إن الذين يكفرون بالله ورسله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «يكفرون» is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يكفرون»; and «رسله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الله﴾.
﴿ويريدون أن يفرقوا بين الله ورسله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause «يريدون» is conjoined to the ṣila clause ﴿يكفرون﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بين» is an adverb attached to «يفرقوا»; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «رسله» is conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿ويقولون نؤمن ببعض ونكفر ببعض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause «يقولون» is conjoined to the ṣila clause, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿نؤمن ببعض﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ببعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نؤمن﴾, and the second to ﴿نكفر﴾.
﴿ويريدون أن يتخذوا بين ذلك سبيلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause «يريدون» is conjoined to the ṣila clause, with no grammatical position; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar that is the first mafʿūl bihi; the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «سبيلًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿إن الذين يكفرون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
[Translator's note: as written, the source calls the interpreted maṣdar the "first" object and «سبيلًا» the "second", although the maṣdar is the object of «يريدون» and «سبيلًا» the object of «يتخذوا».]

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿أولئك هم الكافرون حقا﴾: the demonstrative is the first mubtadaʾ (subject); «هم» is a second mubtadaʾ; «الكافرون» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; the demonstrative clause and what follows it is the khabar of «إن»; and «حقًّا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause, the implied form being "that is true, truly".
﴿وأعتدنا للكافرين عذابا مهينا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «أعتدنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «للكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعتدنا»; «عذابًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «مهينًا» a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿وأعتدنا للكافرين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا بالله ورسله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «الذين» is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا»; and «رسله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الله».
﴿ولم يفرقوا بين أحد منهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to ﴿آمنوا﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila, with no grammatical position; «بين» is an adverb attached to «يفرقوا»; and «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «أحد».
﴿أولئك سوف يؤتيهم أجورهم﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ, and the clause «سوف يؤتيهم» is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of the relative ﴿الذين﴾; and the clause ﴿والذين آمنوا بالله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «غفورا رحيما» are its two khabars; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿يسألك أهل الكتاب أن تنزل عليهم كتابا من السماء﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «يسألك» is a verb and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أهل الكتاب» is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن تنزل﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تنزّل»; «كتابًا» is mafʿūl bihi; and «من السماء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتابًا﴾.
﴿فقد سألوا موسى أكبر من ذلك﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, being the one that occurs as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you find what they said outrageous and are astonished at what they asked out of obstinacy and excess, then they asked Moses before you"; «موسى» is the first mafʿūl bihi. «أكبر»: the second mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it qualifies the maṣdar. «من ذلك»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أكبر».
﴿فقالوا أرنا الله جهرة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «قالوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سألوا»; the clause «أرنا الله» is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أر﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿نا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the Name of Majesty is the second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿جهرة﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is a kind of the maṣdar ﴿الرؤية﴾ ("seeing"), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "that we see Him, beholding Him with our eyes", or from the object, i.e. "that we see Him openly".
﴿فأخذتهم الصاعقة بظلمهم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «بظلمهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أخذتهم», i.e. "because of their wrongdoing".
﴿ثم اتخذوا العجل من بعد ما جاءتهم البينات﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence in the reporting, i.e. "then it was part of their affair that they took the calf"; «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «اتخذوا»; and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with the verb as a maṣdar made genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it, i.e. "after the coming of the clear proofs".
﴿فعفونا عن ذلك﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to what preceded; and ﴿عن ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عفونا﴾.
﴿وآتينا موسى سلطانا مبينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «آتينا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «موسى» is the first mafʿūl bihi and «سلطانًا» the second; and «مبينًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ورفعنا فوقهم الطور بميثاقهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «رفعنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; «فوقهم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رفعنا», and «بميثاقهم» is likewise attached to it; and «الطور» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقلنا لهم ادخلوا الباب سجدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قلنا» is conjoined to what preceded; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قلنا»; the clause «ادخلوا الباب» is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and «سجدًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وقلنا لهم لا تعدوا في السبت﴾: also conjoined to what preceded; the clause «لا تعدوا» is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying; and «في السبت» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تعدوا».
﴿وأخذنا منهم ميثاقا غليظا﴾: also conjoined to what preceded; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أخذنا»; and «غليظًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ميثاقًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:155-155.t:
﴿فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم وكفرهم بآيات الله﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the bāʾ is a preposition; «ما» is a link (ṣila) for emphasis; «نقضهم» is genitive by the bāʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb], its implied form being "We did to them what We did because of their breaking"; «ميثاقهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun), which is «نقض»; «كفرهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «نقضهم»; «بآيات»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كفرهم»; and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وقتلهم الأنبياء بغير حق﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «الأنبياء» is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar, which is «قتلهم»; and «بغير حق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وقولهم قلوبنا غلف﴾: also conjoined; and the clause «قلوبنا غلف», made up of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل طبع الله عليها بكفرهم فلا يؤمنون إلا قليلا﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction, i.e. "the matter is not as they said"; «طبع الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «طبع»; «بكفرهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «طبع», i.e. "because of their disbelief"; the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لا» is negative; «يؤمنون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and «قليلًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "except a little time", so it is an adverb of time attached to «يؤمنون»; or it is accusative as an exception from the fāʿil of «يؤمنون», i.e. "except a few of them".
[Translator's note: as written, the source calls «قليلًا» "a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar" but then glosses the omitted word as "time" and calls it an adverb of time.]

muyesser-irab:156-156.t:
﴿وبكفرهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «بكفرهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) that to which the preposition and its genitive noun in His saying ﴿فبما نقضهم﴾ are attached.
﴿وقولهم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿بكفرهم﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿على مريم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قولهم».
﴿بهتانًا﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) ﴿قولهم﴾, because «البهتان» contains the meaning of speech; or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a kind of the maṣdar; or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a slanderous saying"; or accusative by an implied verb from its own root, i.e. "they slandered a slander"; or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the genitive pronoun in ﴿قولهم﴾ — a ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi being permissible here because it is the agent in meaning — the implied form being "and because they said that, slandering".
﴿عظيمًا﴾: a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t:
﴿وقولهم إنا قتلنا المسيح عيسى ابن مريم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قولهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause «قتلنا المسيح» is its khabar (predicate); «المسيح» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «عيسى» is a badal (substitute) from «المسيح»; «ابن» is a badal or a naʿt (adjective); and «مريم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿رسول الله﴾: a naʿt of «عيسى», or a badal from it, or it is accusative for praise (ʿalā al-madḥ) by an omitted verb.
﴿وما قتلوه وما صلبوه ولكن شبه لهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ما» is negative; «قتلوه» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; «ما صلبوه» is conjoined to ﴿وما قتلوه﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; «لكن» is lightened, for rectification (istidrāk) only; «شبه» is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and it is predicated of the preposition and its genitive noun after it, which is ﴿لهم﴾; or it is predicated of the pronoun of the one killed, because their saying ﴿إنا قتلنا﴾ indicates it, as if it were said: "but the one they killed was made to appear [so] to them"; it is not correct to make it predicated of the Messiah, because he is the one likened to, not the one likened.
﴿وإن الذين اختلفوا فيه لفي شك منه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle, and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «اختلفوا» is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اختلفوا»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿شك﴾, i.e. "in doubt arising from the matter of his killing", ﴿من﴾ thus being for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya).
﴿ما لهم به من علم إلا اتباع الظن وما قتلوه يقينا﴾: this negated clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or in the place of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or in the place of a fronted khabar; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علم﴾, or a ḥāl from it, because it was a naʿt and was put before it; «من» is a linking (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; «علم» is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا اتباع الظن» is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «قتلوه» is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and «يقينًا» is an emphatic ḥāl from the fāʿil of «قتلوه», or a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a certain killing".

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿بل رفعه الله إليه﴾: «بل» is a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb); «رفعه»: a past verb, the hāʾ being a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); and «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رفعه».
﴿وكان الله عزيزا حكيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان الله»: «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; «عزيزا»: the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «حكيما»: a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:159-159.t:
﴿وإن من أهل الكتاب إلا ليؤمنن به قبل موته﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is negative; «من أهل الكتاب» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the oath clause answered by His saying ﴿إلا ليؤمنن﴾; the oath clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ only because it is where the point of the statement lies; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; «يؤمنن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يؤمنن»; and «قبل موته» is an adverb of time attached to «يؤمنن».
﴿ويوم القيامة يكون عليهم شهيدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يوم القيامة» is an adverb attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾; «يكون» is a defective, abrogating imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; «شهيدًا» is the khabar of «يكون»; and ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:160-160.t:
﴿فبظلم من الذين هادوا حرمنا عليهم طيبات أحلت لهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرمنا», the bāʾ being causal (sababiyya); «من الذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «ظلم»; the clause «هادوا» is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; «حرمنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حرمنا»; «طيبات» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «أحلت لهم» is a naʿt of «طيبات».
﴿وبصدهم عن سبيل الله كثيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «بصدهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His saying ﴿فبظلم﴾; «عن سبيل الله»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صد﴾, the Name of Majesty being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿كثيرًا﴾: the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (verbal noun), the meaning being "by their turning many people, or a large group, away"; or a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a great turning away"; or a naʿt of an implied adverb, i.e. "for a long time".

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿وأخذهم الربا وقد نهوا عنه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿صدهم﴾; «الربا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أخذ﴾, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); «نهوا» is a past verb built for what has not had its agent named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «عنه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نهوا»; and the clause «قد نهوا» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأكلهم أموال الناس بالباطل﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «أموال الناس» is the mafʿūl bihi of «أكل»; and «بالباطل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أكلهم», because the bāʾ is causal, or to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "engaged in falsehood, such as bribery, betrayal and the like".
﴿وأعتدنا للكافرين منهم عذابا أليما﴾: conjoined to ﴿حرمنا﴾; «أعتدنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «للكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أعتدنا»; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "those persisting in disbelief, not those of them who believed and repented"; «عذابًا» is mafʿūl bihi; and «أليمًا» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:162-162.t:
﴿لكن الراسخون في العلم منهم والمؤمنون﴾: «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), left without effect (muhmal) because its nūn is lightened; «الراسخون» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «في العلم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it, because it is an active participle; «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in ﴿الراسخون﴾; and «المؤمنون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الراسخون﴾.
﴿يؤمنون بما أنزل إليك وما أنزل من قبلك﴾: the clause «يؤمنون» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿الراسخون﴾, or a ḥāl from them if we take the clause «سنؤتيهم» as the khabar; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يؤمنون»; the clause ﴿أنزل إليك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿وما أنزل من قبلك﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is conjoined to the ṣila and falls within its scope; and «من قبلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿الراسخون في العلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والمقيمين الصلاة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). «المقيمين»: accusative by an implied verb, to show the excellence of the prayer, the implied form being "I mean", or "I single out those who establish the prayer", who perform it in the most complete manner; «الصلاة»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿المقيمين﴾. The clause ﴿والمقيمين الصلاة﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause, or parenthetical, and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿والمؤتون الزكاة﴾: conjoined to what preceded; and «الزكاة» is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿المؤتون﴾, because it is an active participle.
﴿والمؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «المؤمنون» is conjoined to what preceded; «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿المؤمنون﴾; «اليوم» is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; and «الآخر» is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿أولئك سنؤتيهم أجرا عظيما﴾: the clause «أولئك» and what follows it is the khabar of ﴿الراسخون﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position; «أولئك» is mubtadaʾ; the clause «سنؤتيهم» is the khabar; «أجرًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and «عظيمًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿إنا أوحينا إليك كما أوحينا إلى نوح والنبيين من بعده﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause «أوحينا» is the khabar (predicate); «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوحينا»; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, i.e. "We revealed to you a revelation like Our revealing to Noah"; the second clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿أوحينا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). Or the kāf is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the second clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "We revealed to you the like of that which We revealed to Noah". ﴿إلى نوح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أوحينا»; ﴿والنبيين﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «نوح»; and ﴿من بعده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأوحينا إلى إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط وعيسى وأيوب ويونس وهارون وسليمان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أوحينا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «إلى إبراهيم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أوحينا»; and the names of the prophets after it are conjoined to it.
﴿وآتينا داود زبورا﴾: «آتينا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «داود» is the first mafʿūl bihi and «زبورًا» the second.
